live.2-esdras|12:17: As for the voice which you heardest speak, and that you sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:
live.2-esdras|12:18: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.
live.2-esdras|12:19: And whereas you sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:
live.2-esdras|12:20: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.
live.2-esdras|12:21: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept to the end.
live.2-esdras|12:22: And whereas you sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:
live.2-esdras|12:23: In his last days shall the Most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things in it, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,
live.2-esdras|12:24: And of those that dwell in it, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.
live.2-esdras|12:25: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.
live.2-esdras|12:26: And whereas you sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.
live.2-esdras|12:27: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.
live.2-esdras|12:28: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.
live.2-esdras|12:29: And whereas you sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;
live.2-esdras|12:30: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest has kept to their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as you sawest.
live.2-esdras|12:31: And the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which you have heard;
live.2-esdras|12:32: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
live.2-esdras|12:33: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
live.2-esdras|12:34: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
live.2-esdras|12:35: This is the dream that you sawest, and these are the interpretations.
live.2-esdras|12:36: You only have been meet to know this secret of the Highest.
live.2-esdras|12:37: Therefore write all these things that you have seen in a book, and hide them:
live.2-esdras|12:38: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts you know may comprehend and keep these secrets.
live.2-esdras|12:39: But wait you here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed you, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare to you. And with that he went his way.
live.2-esdras|12:40: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least to the greatest, and came to me, and said,
live.2-esdras|12:41: What have we offended you? and what evil have we done against you, that you forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?
live.2-esdras|12:42: For of all the prophets you only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.
live.2-esdras|12:43: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?
live.2-esdras|12:44: If you shall forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?
live.2-esdras|12:45: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,
live.2-esdras|12:46: Be of good comfort, O Yashar'el (Israel); and be not heavy, you house of Jacob:
live.2-esdras|12:47: For the Highest has you in remembrance, and the Mighty has not forgotten you in temptation.
live.2-esdras|12:48: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.
live.2-esdras|12:49: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come to you.
live.2-esdras|12:50: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:
live.2-esdras|12:51: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs.
live.2-esdras|13:1: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:
live.2-esdras|13:2: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.
live.2-esdras|13:3: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.
live.2-esdras|13:4: And whenever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth fails when it feeleth the fire.
live.2-esdras|13:5: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea
live.2-esdras|13:6: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.
live.2-esdras|13:7: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.
live.2-esdras|13:8: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.
live.2-esdras|13:9: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:
live.2-esdras|13:10: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.
live.2-esdras|13:11: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.
live.2-esdras|13:12: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call to him another peaceable Multitude.
live.2-esdras|13:13: And there came much people to him, of which some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,
live.2-esdras|13:14: You have shewed your servant these wonders from the beginning, and have counted me worthy that you should receive my prayer:
live.2-esdras|13:15: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.
live.2-esdras|13:16: For as I conceive in my understanding, woe to them that shall be left in those days and much more woe to them that are not left behind!
live.2-esdras|13:17: For they that were not left were in heaviness.
live.2-esdras|13:18: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen to them, and to those that are left behind.
live.2-esdras|13:19: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.
live.2-esdras|13:20: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered to me, and said,
live.2-esdras|13:21: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew you, and I will open to you the thing that you have required.
live.2-esdras|13:22: Whereas you have spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:
live.2-esdras|13:23: He that shall endure the peril in that time has kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.
live.2-esdras|13:24: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.
live.2-esdras|13:25: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas you sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:
live.2-esdras|13:26: The same is he whom Yahuah (God) the Highest has kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.
live.2-esdras|13:27: And whereas you sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;
live.2-esdras|13:28: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:
live.2-esdras|13:29: Behold, the days come, when the Most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.
live.2-esdras|13:30: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.
live.2-esdras|13:31: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.
live.2-esdras|13:32: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed you before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom you sawest as a man ascending.
live.2-esdras|13:33: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.
live.2-esdras|13:34: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as you sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.
live.2-esdras|13:35: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.
live.2-esdras|13:36: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as you sawest the hill graven without hands.
live.2-esdras|13:37: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;
live.2-esdras|13:38: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments with which they shall begin to be tormented, which are like to a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like to fire.
live.2-esdras|13:39: And whereas you sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude to him;
live.2-esdras|13:40: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.
live.2-esdras|13:41: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,
live.2-esdras|13:42: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.
live.2-esdras|13:43: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.
live.2-esdras|13:44: For the Most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.
live.2-esdras|13:45: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.
live.2-esdras|13:46: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,
live.2-esdras|13:47: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.
live.2-esdras|13:48: But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.
live.2-esdras|13:49: Now when he destroys the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.
live.2-esdras|13:50: And then shall he shew them great wonders.
live.2-esdras|13:51: Then said I, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?
live.2-esdras|13:52: And he said to me, Like as you can neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.
live.2-esdras|13:53: This is the interpretation of the dream which you sawest, and by which you only art here lightened.
live.2-esdras|13:54: For you have forsaken your own way, and applied your diligence to my law, and sought it.
live.2-esdras|13:55: Your life have you ordered in wisdom, and have called understanding your mother.
live.2-esdras|13:56: And therefore have I shewed you the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things to you, and declare to you mighty and wondrous things.
live.2-esdras|13:57: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly to the Most High because of his wonders which he did in time;
live.2-esdras|13:58: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days.
live.2-esdras|14:1: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
live.2-esdras|14:2: And I said, Here am I, Yahuah (God) And I stood up upon my feet.
live.2-esdras|14:3: Then said he to me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself to Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
live.2-esdras|14:4: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
live.2-esdras|14:5: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,
live.2-esdras|14:6: These words shall you declare, and these shall you hide.
live.2-esdras|14:7: And now I say to you,
live.2-esdras|14:8: That you lay up in your heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that you have seen, and the interpretations which you have heard:
live.2-esdras|14:9: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
live.2-esdras|14:10: For the world has lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.
live.2-esdras|14:11: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:
live.2-esdras|14:12: And there remains that which is after the half of the tenth part.
live.2-esdras|14:13: Now therefore set yours house in order, and reprove your people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,
live.2-esdras|14:14: Let go from you mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,
live.2-esdras|14:15: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy to you, and haste you to flee from these times.
live.2-esdras|14:16: For yet greater evils than those which you have seen happen shall be done hereafter.
live.2-esdras|14:17: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell in it.
live.2-esdras|14:18: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which you have seen.
live.2-esdras|14:19: Then answered I before you, and said,
live.2-esdras|14:20: Behold, Yahuah (God), I will go, as you have commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell in it are without light.
live.2-esdras|14:21: For your law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of you, or the work that shall begin.
live.2-esdras|14:22: But if I have found grace before you, send the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) into me, and I shall write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in your law, that men may find your path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
live.2-esdras|14:23: And he answered me, saying, Go your way, gather the people together, and say to them, that they seek you not for forty days.
live.2-esdras|14:24: But look you prepare you many box trees, and take with you Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;
live.2-esdras|14:25: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in yours heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which you shall begin to write.
live.2-esdras|14:26: And when you have done, some things shall you publish, and some things shall you shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shall you begin to write.
live.2-esdras|14:27: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,
live.2-esdras|14:29: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:
live.2-esdras|14:30: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which you also have transgressed after them.
live.2-esdras|14:31: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and you yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.
live.2-esdras|14:32: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.
live.2-esdras|14:33: And now are you here, and your brothers among you.
live.2-esdras|14:34: Therefore if so be that you will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, you shall be kept alive and after death you shall obtain mercy.
live.2-esdras|14:35: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.
live.2-esdras|14:36: Let no man therefore come to me now, nor seek after me these forty days.
live.2-esdras|14:37: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.
live.2-esdras|14:38: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open your mouth, and drink that I give you to drink.
live.2-esdras|14:39: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.
live.2-esdras|14:40: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:
live.2-esdras|14:41: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.
live.2-esdras|14:42: The Highest gave understanding to the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.
live.2-esdras|14:43: As for me. I spoke in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.
live.2-esdras|14:44: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.
live.2-esdras|14:45: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spoke, saying, The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
live.2-esdras|14:46: But keep the seventy last, that you may deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:
live.2-esdras|14:47: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.
live.2-esdras|15:1: Behold, speak you in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in your mouth, says Yahuah (God):
live.2-esdras|15:2: And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.
live.2-esdras|15:3: Fear not the imaginations against you, let not the incredulity of them trouble you, that speak against you.
live.2-esdras|15:4: For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.
live.2-esdras|15:5: Behold, says Yahuah (God), I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.
live.2-esdras|15:6: For wickedness has exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.
live.2-esdras|15:8: I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves: behold, the innocent and righteous blood cries to me, and the souls of the just complain continually.
live.2-esdras|15:9: And therefore, says Yahuah (God), I will surely avenge them, and receive to me all the innocent blood from among them.
live.2-esdras|15:10: Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt:
live.2-esdras|15:11: But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof.
live.2-esdras|15:12: Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be struck with the plague and punishment that Yahuah (God) shall bring upon it.
live.2-esdras|15:13: They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.
live.2-esdras|15:14: Woe to the world and them that dwell in it!
live.2-esdras|15:15: For the sword and their destruction draws nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.
live.2-esdras|15:16: For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.
live.2-esdras|15:17: A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.
live.2-esdras|15:18: For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.
live.2-esdras|15:19: A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.
live.2-esdras|15:20: Behold, says Yahuah (God), I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.
live.2-esdras|15:21: Like as they do yet this day to my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus says Yahuah (God);
live.2-esdras|15:22: My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.
live.2-esdras|15:23: The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and has consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled.
live.2-esdras|15:24: Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! says Yahuah (God).
live.2-esdras|15:25: I will not spare them: go your way, you children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary.
live.2-esdras|15:26: For Yahuah (God) knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivers he them to death and destruction.
live.2-esdras|15:27: For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth and you shall remain in them: for Yahuah (God) shall not deliver you, because you have sinned against him.
live.2-esdras|15:28: Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:
live.2-esdras|15:29: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.
live.2-esdras|15:30: Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.
live.2-esdras|15:31: And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,
live.2-esdras|15:32: Then these shall be troubled bled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.
live.2-esdras|15:33: And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.
live.2-esdras|15:34: Behold clouds from the east and from the north to the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.
live.2-esdras|15:35: They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword to the belly,
live.2-esdras|15:36: And dung of men to the camel’s hough.
live.2-esdras|15:37: And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.
live.2-esdras|15:38: And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.
live.2-esdras|15:39: And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it; and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.
live.2-esdras|15:40: The great and mighty clouds shall be puffed up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell in it; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star,
live.2-esdras|15:41: Fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters.
live.2-esdras|15:42: And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.
live.2-esdras|15:43: And they shall go stedfastly to Babylon, and make her afraid.
live.2-esdras|15:44: They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up to the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.
live.2-esdras|15:45: And they that remain under her shall do service to them that have put her in fear.
live.2-esdras|15:46: And you, Asia, that are partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person:
live.2-esdras|15:47: Woe be to you, you wretch, because you have made thyself like to her; and have decked your daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in your lovers, which have always desired to commit whoredom with you.
live.2-esdras|15:48: You have followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions: therefore says Yahuah (God),
live.2-esdras|15:49: I will send plagues upon you; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste your houses with destruction and death.
live.2-esdras|15:50: And the glory of your Power shall be dried up as a flower, the heat shall arise that is sent over you.
live.2-esdras|15:51: You shall be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive you.
live.2-esdras|15:52: Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against you, says Yahuah (God),
live.2-esdras|15:53: If you had not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of yours hands, and saying over their dead, when you were drunken,
live.2-esdras|15:54: Set forth the beauty of your countenance?
live.2-esdras|15:55: The reward of your whoredom shall be in your bosom, therefore shall you receive recompence.
live.2-esdras|15:56: Like as you have done to my chosen, says Yahuah (God), even so shall Yahuah (God) do to you, and shall deliver you into mischief
live.2-esdras|15:57: Your children shall die of hunger, and you shall fall through the sword: your cities shall be broken down, and all yours shall perish with the sword in the field.
live.2-esdras|15:58: They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.
live.2-esdras|15:59: You as unhappy shall come through the sea, and receive plagues again.
live.2-esdras|15:60: And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of your land, and consume part of your glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.
live.2-esdras|15:61: And you shall be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be to you as fire;
live.2-esdras|15:62: And shall consume you, and your cities, your land, and your mountains; all your woods and your fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire.
live.2-esdras|15:63: Your children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what you have, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of your face.
live.2-esdras|16:1: Woe be to you, Babylon, and Asia! woe be to you, Egypt and Syria!
live.2-esdras|16:2: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.
live.2-esdras|16:3: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?
live.2-esdras|16:4: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?
live.2-esdras|16:5: Plagues are sent to you, and what is he that may drive them away?
live.2-esdras|16:6: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it has begun to burn?
live.2-esdras|16:7: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?
live.2-esdras|16:8: The mighty Yahuah (God) sends the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?
live.2-esdras|16:9: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?
live.2-esdras|16:10: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?
live.2-esdras|16:11: Yahuah (God) shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?
live.2-esdras|16:12: The earth quakes, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before Yahuah (God), and before the glory of his power:
live.2-esdras|16:13: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.
live.2-esdras|16:14: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.
live.2-esdras|16:15: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.
live.2-esdras|16:16: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returns not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.
live.2-esdras|16:17: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?
live.2-esdras|16:18: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?
live.2-esdras|16:19: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.
live.2-esdras|16:20: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.
live.2-esdras|16:21: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.
live.2-esdras|16:22: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.
live.2-esdras|16:23: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.
live.2-esdras|16:24: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it
live.2-esdras|16:25: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?
live.2-esdras|16:26: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:
live.2-esdras|16:27: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.
live.2-esdras|16:28: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.
live.2-esdras|16:29: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;
live.2-esdras|16:30: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:
live.2-esdras|16:31: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.
live.2-esdras|16:32: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.
live.2-esdras|16:33: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.
live.2-esdras|16:34: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.
live.2-esdras|16:35: Hear now these things and understand them, you servants of Yahuah (God).
live.2-esdras|16:36: Behold, the word of Yahuah (God), receive it: believe not the gods of whom Yahuah (God) spoke.
live.2-esdras|16:37: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.
live.2-esdras|16:38: As when a woman with child in the ninth month brings forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child comes forth, they slack not a moment:
live.2-esdras|16:39: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.
live.2-esdras|16:40: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to your battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.
live.2-esdras|16:41: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:
live.2-esdras|16:42: He that occupieth merchandise, as he that has no profit by it: and he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell in it:
live.2-esdras|16:43: He that sows, as if he should not reap: so also he that planteth the vineyard, as he that shall not gather the grapes:
live.2-esdras|16:44: They that marry, as they that shall get no children; and they that marry not, as the widowers.
live.2-esdras|16:45: And therefore they that labour labour in vain:
live.2-esdras|16:46: For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.
live.2-esdras|16:47: And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery, the more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons:
live.2-esdras|16:48: The more will I be angry with them for their sin, says Yahuah (God).
live.2-esdras|16:49: Like as a whore envies a right honest and virtuous woman:
live.2-esdras|16:50: So shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face, when he comes that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth.
live.2-esdras|16:51: And therefore be you not like to it, nor to the works thereof.
live.2-esdras|16:52: For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you.
live.2-esdras|16:53: Let not the sinner say that he has not sinned: for Yahuah (God) shall burn coals of fire upon his head, which says before Yahuah (God) and his glory, I have not sinned.
live.2-esdras|16:54: Behold, Yahuah (God) knoweth all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts:
live.2-esdras|16:55: Which spoke but the word, Let the earth be made; and it was made: Let the heaven be made; and it was created.
live.2-esdras|16:56: In his word were the stars made, and he knoweth the number of them.
live.2-esdras|16:57: He searcheth the deep, and the treasures thereof; he has measured the sea, and what it containeth.
live.2-esdras|16:58: He has shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word has he hanged the earth upon the waters.
live.2-esdras|16:59: He spreadeth out the heavens like a vault; upon the waters has he founded it.
live.2-esdras|16:60: In the desert has he made springs of water, and pools upon the tops of the mountains, that the floods might pour down from the high rocks to water the earth.
live.2-esdras|16:61: He made man, and put his heart in the midst of the body, and gave him breath, life, and understanding.
live.2-esdras|16:62: Yea and the Spirit of Almighty Yahuah (God), which made all things, and searcheth out all hidden things in the secrets of the earth,
live.2-esdras|16:63: Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what you think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.
live.2-esdras|16:64: Therefore has Yahuah (God) exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame.
live.2-esdras|16:65: And when your sins are brought forth, you shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.
live.2-esdras|16:66: What will you do? or how will you hide your sins before Yahuah (God) and his angels?
live.2-esdras|16:67: Behold, Yahuah (God) himself is the judge, fear him: leave off from your sins, and forget your iniquities, to meddle no more with them for ever: so shall Yahuah (God) lead you forth, and deliver you from all trouble.
live.2-esdras|16:68: For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered to idols.
live.2-esdras|16:69: And they that consent to them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.
live.2-esdras|16:70: For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear Yahuah (God).
live.2-esdras|16:71: They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear Yahuah (God).
live.2-esdras|16:72: For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses.
live.2-esdras|16:73: Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.
live.2-esdras|16:74: Hear, O you my beloved, says Yahuah (God): behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.
live.2-esdras|16:75: Be you not afraid neither doubt; for Yahuah (God) is your guide,
live.2-esdras|16:76: And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, says Yahuah (God): let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.
live.2-esdras|16:77: Woe be to them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through!
live.2-esdras|16:78: It is left undressed, and is cast into the fire to be consumed with it.
live.tobit|1:1: The book of the words of Tobit, son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, the son of Aduel, the son of Gabael, of the seed of Asael, of the tribe of Nephthali;
live.tobit|1:2: Who in the time of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was led captive out of Thisbe, which is at the right hand of that city, which is called properly Nephthali in Galilee above Aser.
live.tobit|1:3: I Tobit have walked all the days of my life in the ways of truth and justice, and I did many almsdeeds to my brothers, and my nation, who came with me to Nineve, into the land of the Assyrians.
live.tobit|1:4: And when I was in my own country, in the land of Yashar'el (Israel) being but young, all the tribe of Nephthali my father fell from the house of Jerusalem, which was chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), that all the tribes should sacrifice there, where the temple of the habitation of the Most High was consecrated and built for all ages.
live.tobit|1:5: Now all the tribes which together revolted, and the house of my father Nephthali, sacrificed to the heifer Baal.
live.tobit|1:6: But I alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, as it was ordained to all the people of Yashar'el (Israel) by an everlasting decree, having the firstfruits and tenths of increase, with that which was first shorn; and them gave I at the altar to the priests the children of Aaron.
live.tobit|1:7: The first tenth part of all increase I gave to the sons of Aaron, who ministered at Jerusalem: another tenth part I sold away, and went, and spent it every year at Jerusalem:
live.tobit|1:8: And the third I gave to them to whom it was meet, as Debora my father’s mother had commanded me, because I was left an orphan by my father.
live.tobit|1:9: Furthermore, when I was come to the age of a man, I married Anna of my own kindred, and of her I begat Tobias.
live.tobit|1:10: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brothers and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.
live.tobit|1:11: But I kept myself from eating;
live.tobit|1:12: Because I remembered Yahuah (God) with all my heart.
live.tobit|1:13: And the Most High gave me grace and favour before Enemessar, so that I was his purveyor.
live.tobit|1:14: And I went into Media, and left in trust with Gabael, the brother of Gabrias, at Rages a city of Media ten talents of silver.
live.tobit|1:15: Now when Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead; whose estate was troubled, that I could not go into Media.
live.tobit|1:16: And in the time of Enemessar I gave many alms to my brothers, and gave my bread to the hungry,
live.tobit|1:17: And my clothes to the naked: and if I saw any of my nation dead, or cast about the walls of Nineve, I buried him.
live.tobit|1:18: And if the king Sennacherib had slain any, when he was come, and fled from Judea, I buried them privily; for in his wrath he killed many; but the bodies were not found, when they were sought for of the king.
live.tobit|1:19: And when one of the Ninevites went and complained of me to the king, that I buried them, and hid myself; understanding that I was sought for to be put to death, I withdrew myself for fear.
live.tobit|1:20: Then all my goods were forcibly taken away, neither was there any thing left me, beside my wife Anna and my son Tobias.
live.tobit|1:21: And there passed not five and fifty days, before two of his sons killed him, and they fled into the mountains of Ararath; and Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead; who appointed over his father’s accounts, and over all his affairs, Achiacharus my brother Anael’s son.
live.tobit|1:22: And Achiacharus intreating for me, I returned to Nineve. Now Achiacharus was cupbearer, and keeper of the signet, and steward, and overseer of the accounts: and Sarchedonus appointed him next to him: and he was my brother’s son.
live.tobit|2:1: Now when I was come home again, and my wife Anna was restored to me, with my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared me, in the which I sat down to eat.
live.tobit|2:2: And when I saw abundance of meat, I said to my son, Go and bring what poor man soever you shall find out of our brothers, who is mindful of Yahuah (God); and, lo, I tarry for you.
live.tobit|2:3: But he came again, and said, Father, one of our nation is strangled, and is cast out in the marketplace.
live.tobit|2:4: Then before I had tasted of any meat, I started up, and took him up into a room until the going down of the sun.
live.tobit|2:5: Then I returned, and washed myself, and ate my meat in heaviness,
live.tobit|2:6: Remembering that prophecy of Amos, as he said, Your feasts shall be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.
live.tobit|2:7: Therefore I wept: and after the going down of the sun I went and made a grave, and buried him.
live.tobit|2:8: But my neighbours mocked me, and said, This man is not yet afraid to be put to death for this matter: who fled away; and yet, lo, he burieth the dead again.
live.tobit|2:9: The same night also I returned from the burial, and slept by the wall of my courtyard, being polluted and my face was uncovered:
live.tobit|2:10: And I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and my eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into my eyes, and a whiteness came in my eyes: and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.
live.tobit|2:11: And my wife Anna did take women’s works to do.
live.tobit|2:12: And when she had sent them home to the owners, they paid her wages, and gave her also besides a kid.
live.tobit|2:13: And when it was in my house, and began to cry, I said to her, From whence is this kid? is it not stolen? render it to the owners; for it is not lawful to eat any thing that is stolen.
live.tobit|2:14: But she replied upon me, It was given for a gift more than the wages. Howbeit I did not believe her, but told her render it to the owners: and I was abashed at her. But she replied upon me, Where are your alms and your righteous deeds? behold, you and all your works are known.
live.tobit|3:1: Then I being grieved did weep, and in my sorrow prayed, saying,
live.tobit|3:2: O Yahuah (God), you are just, and all your works and all your ways are mercy and truth, and you judgest truly and justly for ever.
live.tobit|3:3: Remember me, and look on me, punish me not for my sins and ignorances, and the sins of my fathers, who have sinned before you:
live.tobit|3:4: For they obeyed not your commandments: wherefore you have delivered us for a spoil, and to captivity, and to death, and for a proverb of reproach to all the nations among whom we are dispersed.
live.tobit|3:5: And now your judgments are many and true: deal with me according to my sins and my fathers’: because we have not kept your commandments, neither have walked in truth before you.
live.tobit|3:6: Now therefore deal with me as seemeth best to you, and command my spirit to be taken from me, that I may be dissolved, and become earth: for it is profitable for me to die rather than to live, because I have heard false reproaches, and have much sorrow: command therefore that I may now be delivered out of this distress, and go into the everlasting place: turn not your face away from me.
live.tobit|3:7: It came to pass the same day, that in Ecbatane a city of Media Sara the daughter of Raguel was also reproached by her father’s maids;
live.tobit|3:8: Because that she had been married to seven husbands, whom Asmodeus the evil spirit had killed, before they had lain with her. Do you not know, said they, that you have strangled yours husbands? you have had already seven husbands, neither were you named after any of them.
live.tobit|3:9: Wherefore do you beat us for them? if they be dead, go your ways after them, let us never see of you either son or daughter.
live.tobit|3:10: Whe she heard these things, she was very sorrowful, so that she thought to have strangled herself; and she said, I am the only daughter of my father, and if I do this, it shall be a reproach to him, and I shall bring his old age with sorrow to the grave.
live.tobit|3:11: Then she prayed toward the window, and said, Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God), my Elohim (God), and yours holy and glorious name is blessed and honourable for ever: let all your works praise you for ever.
live.tobit|3:12: And now, O Yahuah (God), I set my eyes and my face toward you,
live.tobit|3:13: And say, Take me out of the earth, that I may hear no more the reproach.
live.tobit|3:14: You know, Yahuah (God), that I am pure from all sin with man,
live.tobit|3:15: And that I never polluted my name, nor the name of my father, in the land of my captivity: I am the only daughter of my father, neither has he any child to be his heir, neither any near kinsman, nor any son of his alive, to whom I may keep myself for a wife: my seven husbands are already dead; and why should I live? but if it please not you that I should die, command some regard to be had of me, and pity taken of me, that I hear no more reproach.
live.tobit|3:16: So the prayers of them both were heard before the majesty of the great Yahuah (God).
live.tobit|3:17: And Raphael was sent to heal them both, that is, to scale away the whiteness of Tobit’s eyes, and to give Sara the daughter of Raguel for a wife to Tobias the son of Tobit; and to bind Asmodeus the evil spirit; because she belonged to Tobias by right of inheritance. The selfsame time came Tobit home, and entered into his house, and Sara the daughter of Raguel came down from her upper chamber.
live.tobit|4:1: In that day Tobit remembered the money which he had committed to Gabael in Rages of Media,
live.tobit|4:2: And said with himself, I have wished for death; wherefore do I not call for my son Tobias that I may signify to him of the money before I die?
live.tobit|4:3: And when he had called him, he said, My son, when I am dead, bury me; and despise not your mother, but honour her all the days of your life, and do that which shall please her, and grieve her not.
live.tobit|4:4: Remember, my son, that she saw many dangers for you, when you were in her womb: and when she is dead, bury her by me in one grave.
live.tobit|4:5: My son, be mindful of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) all your days, and let not your will be set to sin, or to transgress his commandments: do uprightly all your life long, and follow not the ways of unrighteousness.
live.tobit|4:6: For if you deal truly, your doings shall prosperously succeed to you, and to all them that live justly.
live.tobit|4:7: Give alms of your substance; and when you give alms, let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.
live.tobit|4:8: If you have abundance give alms accordingly: if you have but a little, be not afraid to give according to that little:
live.tobit|4:9: For you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.
live.tobit|4:10: Because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.
live.tobit|4:11: For alms is a good gift to all that give it in the sight of the Most High.
live.tobit|4:12: Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of your fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of your father’s tribe: for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.
live.tobit|4:13: Now therefore, my son, love your brothers, and despise not in your heart your brothers, the sons and daughters of your people, in not taking a wife of them: for in pride is destruction and much trouble, and in lewdness is decay and great want: for lewdness is the mother of famine.
live.tobit|4:14: Let not the wages of any man, which has wrought for you, tarry with you, but give him it out of hand: for if you serve Yahuah (God), he will also repay you: be circumspect my son, in all things you do, and be wise in all your conversation.
live.tobit|4:15: Do that to no man which you hatest: drink not wine to make you drunken: neither let drunkenness go with you in your journey.
live.tobit|4:16: Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked; and according to your abundance give alms: and let not your eye be envious, when you give alms.
live.tobit|4:17: Pour out your bread on the burial of the just, but give nothing to the wicked.
live.tobit|4:18: Ask counsel of all that are wise, and despise not any counsel that is profitable.
live.tobit|4:19: Bless Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God) alway, and desire of him that your ways may be directed, and that all your paths and counsels may prosper: for every nation has not counsel; but Yahuah (God) himself gives all good things, and he humbleth whom he will, as he will; now therefore, my son, remember my commandments, neither let them be put out of your mind.
live.tobit|4:20: And now I signify this to they that I committed ten talents to Gabael the son of Gabrias at Rages in Media.
live.tobit|4:21: And fear not, my son, that we are made poor: for you have much wealth, if you fear Yahuah (God), and depart from all sin, and do that which is pleasing in his sight.
live.tobit|5:1: Tobias then answered and said, Father, I will do all things which you have commanded me:
live.tobit|5:2: But how can I receive the money, seeing I know him not?
live.tobit|5:3: Then he gave him the handwriting, and said to him, Seek you a man which may go with you, whiles I yet live, and I will give him wages: and go and receive the money.
live.tobit|5:4: Therefore when he went to seek a man, he found Raphael that was an angel.
live.tobit|5:5: But he knew not; and he said to him, Can you go with me to Rages? and knowest you those places well?
live.tobit|5:6: To whom the angel said, I will go with you, and I know the way well: for I have lodged with our brother Gabael.
live.tobit|5:7: Then Tobias said to him, Tarry for me, till I tell my father.
live.tobit|5:8: Then he said to him, Go and tarry not. So he went in and said to his father, Behold, I have found one which will go with me. Then he said, Call him to me, that I may know of what tribe he is, and whether he be a trusty man to go with you.
live.tobit|5:9: So he called him, and he came in, and they saluted one another.
live.tobit|5:10: Then Tobit said to him, Brother, shew me of what tribe and family you are.
live.tobit|5:11: To whom he said, Do you seek for a tribe or family, or an hired man to go with your son? Then Tobit said to him, I would know, brother, your kindred and name.
live.tobit|5:12: Then he said, I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of your brothers.
live.tobit|5:13: Then Tobit said, You are welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know your tribe and your family; for you are my brother, of an honest and good stock: for I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brothers: my brother, you are of a good stock.
live.tobit|5:14: But tell me, what wages shall I give you? will you a drachm a day, and things necessary, as to my own son?
live.tobit|5:15: Yea, moreover, if you return safe, I will add something to your wages.
live.tobit|5:16: So they were well pleased. Then said he to Tobias, Prepare thyself for the journey, and Yahuah (God) send you a good journey. And when his son had prepared all things for the journey, his father said, Go you with this man, and Yahuah (God), which dwells in heaven, prosper your journey, and the angel of Yahuah (God) keep you company. So they went forth both, and the young man’s dog with them.
live.tobit|5:17: But Anna his mother wept, and said to Tobit, Why have you sent away our son? is he not the staff of our hand, in going in and out before us?
live.tobit|5:18: Be not greedy to add money to money: but let it be as refuse in respect of our child.
live.tobit|5:19: For that which Yahuah (God) has given us to live with does suffice us.
live.tobit|5:20: Then said Tobit to her, Take no care, my sister; he shall return in safety, and your eyes shall see him.
live.tobit|5:21: For the good angel will keep him company, and his journey shall be prosperous, and he shall return safe.
live.tobit|5:22: Then she made an end of weeping.
live.tobit|6:1: And as they went on their journey, they came in the evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.
live.tobit|6:2: And when the young man went down to wash himself, a fish leaped out of the river, and would have devoured him.
live.tobit|6:3: Then the angel said to him, Take the fish. And the young man laid hold of the fish, and drew it to land.
live.tobit|6:4: To whom the angel said, Open the fish, and take the heart and the liver and the gall, and put them up safely.
live.tobit|6:5: So the young man did as the angel commanded him; and when they had roasted the fish, they did eat it: then they both went on their way, till they drew near to Ecbatane.
live.tobit|6:6: Then the young man said to the angel, Brother Azarias, to what use is the heart and the liver and the gal of the fish?
live.tobit|6:7: And he said to him, Touching the heart and the liver, if a devil or an evil spirit trouble any, we must make a smoke thereof before the man or the woman, and the party shall be no more vexed.
live.tobit|6:8: As for the gall, it is good to anoint a man that has whiteness in his eyes, and he shall be healed.
live.tobit|6:9: And when they were come near to Rages,
live.tobit|6:10: The angel said to the young man, Brother, to day we shall lodge with Raguel, who is your cousin; he also has one only daughter, named Sara; I will speak for her, that she may be given you for a wife.
live.tobit|6:11: For to you does the right of her appertain, seeing you only art of her kindred.
live.tobit|6:12: And the maid is fair and wise: now therefore hear me, and I will speak to her father; and when we return from Rages we will celebrate the marriage: for I know that Raguel cannot marry her to another according to the law of Moses, but he shall be guilty of death, because the right of inheritance does rather appertain to you than to any other.
live.tobit|6:13: Then the young man answered the angel, I have heard, brother Azarias that this maid has been given to seven men, who all died in the marriage chamber.
live.tobit|6:14: And now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest if I go in to her, I die, as the other before: for a wicked spirit loves her, which hurteth no body, but those which come to her; wherefore I also fear lest I die, and bring my father’s and my mother’s life because of me to the grave with sorrow: for they have no other son to bury them.
live.tobit|6:15: Then the angel said to him, Do you not remember the precepts which your father gave you, that you should marry a wife of your own kindred? wherefore hear me, O my brother; for she shall be given you to wife; and make you no reckoning of the evil spirit; for this same night shall she be given you in marriage.
live.tobit|6:16: And when you shall come into the marriage chamber, you shall take the ashes of perfume, and shall lay upon them some of the heart and liver of the fish, and shall make a smoke with it:
live.tobit|6:17: And the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more: but when you shall come to her, rise up both of you, and pray to Yahuah (God) which is merciful, who will have pity on you, and save you: fear not, for she is appointed to you from the beginning; and you shall preserve her, and she shall go with you. Moreover I suppose that she shall bear you children. Now when Tobias had heard these things, he loved her, and his heart was effectually joined to her.
live.tobit|7:1: And when they were come to Ecbatane, they came to the house of Raguel, and Sara met them: and after they had saluted one another, she brought them into the house.
live.tobit|7:2: Then said Raguel to Edna his wife, How like is this young man to Tobit my cousin!
live.tobit|7:3: And Raguel asked them, From whence are you, brothers? To whom they said, We are of the sons of Nephthalim, which are captives in Nineve.
live.tobit|7:4: Then he said to them, Do you know Tobit our kinsman? And they said, We know him. Then said he, Is he in good health?
live.tobit|7:5: And they said, He is both alive, and in good health: and Tobias said, He is my father.
live.tobit|7:6: Then Raguel leaped up, and kissed him, and wept,
live.tobit|7:7: And blessed him, and said to him, You are the son of an honest and good man. But when he had heard that Tobit was blind, he was sorrowful, and wept.
live.tobit|7:8: And likewise Edna his wife and Sara his daughter wept. Moreover they entertained them cheerfully; and after that they had killed a ram of the flock, they set store of meat on the table. Then said Tobias to Raphael, Brother Azarias, speak of those things of which you did talk in the way, and let this business be dispatched.
live.tobit|7:9: So he communicated the matter with Raguel: and Raguel said to Tobias, Eat and drink, and make merry:
live.tobit|7:10: For it is meet that you should marry my daughter: nevertheless I will declare to you the truth.
live.tobit|7:11: I have given my daughter in marriage to seven men, who died that night they came in to her: nevertheless for the present be merry. But Tobias said, I will eat nothing here, till we agree and swear one to another.
live.tobit|7:12: Raguel said, Then take her from henceforth according to the manner, for you are her cousin, and she is yours, and the merciful Yahuah (God) give you good success in all things.
live.tobit|7:13: Then he called his daughter Sara, and she came to her father, and he took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife to Tobias, saying, Behold, take her after the law of Moses, and lead her away to your father. And he blessed them;
live.tobit|7:14: And called Edna his wife, and took paper, and did write an instrument of covenants, and sealed it.
live.tobit|7:16: After Raguel called his wife Edna, and said to her, Sister, prepare another chamber, and bring her in thither.
live.tobit|7:17: Which when she had done as he had bidden her, she brought her thither: and she wept, and she received the tears of her daughter, and said to her,
live.tobit|7:18: Be of good comfort, my daughter; Yahuah (God) of heaven and earth give you joy for this your sorrow: be of good comfort, my daughter.
live.tobit|8:1: And when they had supped, they brought Tobias in to her.
live.tobit|8:2: And as he went, he remembered the words of Raphael, and took the ashes of the perfumes, and put the heart and the liver of the fish thereupon, and made a smoke with it.
live.tobit|8:3: The which smell when the evil spirit had smelled, he fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him.
live.tobit|8:4: And after that they were both shut in together, Tobias rose out of the bed, and said, Sister, arise, and let us pray that Yahuah (God) would have pity on us.
live.tobit|8:5: Then began Tobias to say, Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God) of our fathers, and blessed is your holy and glorious name for ever; let the heavens bless you, and all your creatures.
live.tobit|8:6: You madest Adam, and gavest him Eve his wife for an helper and stay: of them came mankind: you have said, It is not good that man should be alone; let us make to him an aid like to himself.
live.tobit|8:7: And now, O Yahuah (God), I take not this my sister for lust but uprightly: therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.
live.tobit|8:8: And she said with him, Amen.
live.tobit|8:9: So they slept both that night. And Raguel arose, and went and made a grave,
live.tobit|8:10: Saying, I fear lest he also be dead.
live.tobit|8:11: But when Raguel was come into his house,
live.tobit|8:12: He said to his wife Edna. Send one of the maids, and let her see whether he be alive: if he be not, that we may bury him, and no man know it.
live.tobit|8:13: So the maid opened the door, and went in, and found them both asleep,
live.tobit|8:14: And came forth, and told them that he was alive.
live.tobit|8:15: Then Raguel praised Yahuah (God), and said, O Yahuah (God), you are worthy to be praised with all pure and holy praise; therefore let your saints praise you with all your creatures; and let all your angels and your elect praise you for ever.
live.tobit|8:16: You are to be praised, for you have made me joyful; and that is not come to me which I suspected; but you have dealt with us according to your great mercy.
live.tobit|8:17: You are to be praised because you have had mercy of two that were the only begotten children of their fathers: grant them mercy, O Yahuah (God), and finish their life in health with joy and mercy.
live.tobit|8:18: Then Raguel told his servants to fill the grave.
live.tobit|8:19: And he kept the wedding feast fourteen days.
live.tobit|8:20: For before the days of the marriage were finished, Raguel had said to him by an oath, that he should not depart till the fourteen days of the marriage were expired;
live.tobit|8:21: And then he should take the half of his goods, and go in safety to his father; and should have the rest when I and my wife be dead.
live.tobit|9:1: Then Tobias called Raphael, and said to him,
live.tobit|9:2: Brother Azarias, take with you a servant, and two camels, and go to Rages of Media to Gabael, and bring me the money, and bring him to the wedding.
live.tobit|9:3: For Raguel has sworn that I shall not depart.
live.tobit|9:4: But my father counteth the days; and if I tarry long, he will be very sorry.
live.tobit|9:5: So Raphael went out, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting: who brought forth bags which were sealed up, and gave them to him.
live.tobit|9:6: And early in the morning they went forth both together, and came to the wedding: and Tobias blessed his wife.
live.tobit|10:1: Now Tobit his father counted every day: and when the days of the journey were expired, and they came not,
live.tobit|10:2: Then Tobit said, Are they detained? or is Gabael dead, and there is no man to give him the money?
live.tobit|10:4: Then his wife said to him, My son is dead, seeing he stayeth long; and she began to wail him, and said,
live.tobit|10:5: Now I care for nothing, my son, since I have let you go, the light of my eyes.
live.tobit|10:6: To whom Tobit said, Hold your peace, take no care, for he is safe.
live.tobit|10:7: But she said, Hold your peace, and deceive me not; my son is dead. And she went out every day into the way which they went, and did eat no meat on the daytime, and ceased not whole nights to bewail her son Tobias, until the fourteen days of the wedding were expired, which Raguel had sworn that he should spend there. Then Tobias said to Raguel, Let me go, for my father and my mother look no more to see me.
live.tobit|10:8: But his father in law said to him, Tarry with me, and I will send to your father, and they shall declare to him how things go with you.
live.tobit|10:9: But Tobias said, No; but let me go to my father.
live.tobit|10:10: Then Raguel arose, and gave him Sara his wife, and half his goods, servants, and cattle, and money:
live.tobit|10:11: And he blessed them, and sent them away, saying, Yahuah (God) of heaven give you a prosperous journey, my children.
live.tobit|10:12: And he said to his daughter, Honour your father and your mother in law, which are now your parents, that I may hear good report of you. And he kissed her. Edna also said to Tobias, Yahuah (God) of heaven restore you, my dear brother, and grant that I may see your children of my daughter Sara before I die, that I may rejoice before Yahuah (God): behold, I commit my daughter to you of special trust; where are do not entreat her evil.
live.tobit|11:1: After these things Tobias went his way, praising Yahuah (God) that he had given him a prosperous journey, and blessed Raguel and Edna his wife, and went on his way till they drew near to Nineve.
live.tobit|11:2: Then Raphael said to Tobias, You know, brother, how you did leave your father:
live.tobit|11:3: Let us haste before your wife, and prepare the house.
live.tobit|11:4: And take in yours hand the gall of the fish. So they went their way, and the dog went after them.
live.tobit|11:5: Now Anna sat looking about toward the way for her son.
live.tobit|11:6: And when she espied him coming, she said to his father, Behold, your son comes, and the man that went with him.
live.tobit|11:7: Then said Raphael, I know, Tobias, that your father will open his eyes.
live.tobit|11:8: Therefore anoint you his eyes with the gall, and being pricked with it, he shall rub, and the whiteness shall fall away, and he shall see you.
live.tobit|11:9: Then Anna ran forth, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, Seeing I have seen you, my son, from henceforth I am content to die. And they wept both.
live.tobit|11:10: Tobit also went forth toward the door, and stumbled: but his son ran to him,
live.tobit|11:11: And took hold of his father: and he strake of the gall on his fathers’ eyes, saying, Be of good hope, my father.
live.tobit|11:12: And when his eyes began to smart, he rubbed them;
live.tobit|11:13: And the whiteness pilled away from the corners of his eyes: and when he saw his son, he fell upon his neck.
live.tobit|11:14: And he wept, and said, Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God), and blessed is your name for ever; and blessed are all yours holy angels:
live.tobit|11:15: For you have scourged, and have taken pity on me: for, behold, I see my son Tobias. And his son went in rejoicing, and told his father the great things that had happened to him in Media.
live.tobit|11:16: Then Tobit went out to meet his daughter in law at the gate of Nineve, rejoicing and praising Yahuah (God): and they which saw him go marvelled, because he had received his sight.
live.tobit|11:17: But Tobias gave thanks before them, because Yahuah (God) had mercy on him. And when he came near to Sara his daughter in law, he blessed her, saying, You are welcome, daughter: Yahuah (God) be blessed, which has brought you to us, and blessed be your father and your mother. And there was joy among all his brothers which were at Nineve.
live.tobit|11:18: And Achiacharus, and Nasbas his brother’s son, came:
live.tobit|11:19: And Tobias’ wedding was kept seven days with great joy.
live.tobit|12:1: Then Tobit called his son Tobias, and said to him, My son, see that the man have his wages, which went with you, and you must give him more.
live.tobit|12:2: And Tobias said to him, O father, it is no harm to me to give him half of those things which I have brought:
live.tobit|12:3: For he has brought me again to you in safety, and made whole my wife, and brought me the money, and likewise healed you.
live.tobit|12:4: Then the old man said, It is due to him.
live.tobit|12:5: So he called the angel, and he said to him, Take half of all that you have brought and go away in safety.
live.tobit|12:6: Then he took them both apart, and said to them, Bless Yahuah (God), praise him, and magnify him, and praise him for the things which he has done to you in the sight of all that live. It is good to praise Yahuah (God), and exalt his name, and honourably to shew forth the works of Yahuah (God); therefore be not slack to praise him.
live.tobit|12:7: It is good to keep close the secret of a king, but it is honourable to reveal the works of Yahuah (God). Do that which is good, and no evil shall touch you.
live.tobit|12:8: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:
live.tobit|12:9: For alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:
live.tobit|12:10: But they that sin are enemies to their own life.
live.tobit|12:11: Surely I will keep close nothing from you. For I said, It was good to keep close the secret of a king, but that it was honourable to reveal the works of Yahuah (God).
live.tobit|12:12: Now therefore, when you did pray, and Sara your daughter in law, I did bring the remembrance of your prayers before the Holy One: and when you did bury the dead, I was with you likewise.
live.tobit|12:13: And when you did not delay to rise up, and leave your dinner, to go and cover the dead, your good deed was not hid from me: but I was with you.
live.tobit|12:14: And now Yahuah (God) has sent me to heal you and Sara your daughter in law.
live.tobit|12:15: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.
live.tobit|12:16: Then they were both troubled, and fell upon their faces: for they feared.
live.tobit|12:17: But he said to them, Fear not, for it shall go well with you; praise Yahuah (God) therefore.
live.tobit|12:18: For not of any favour of mine, but by the will of our Elohim (God) I came; wherefore praise him for ever.
live.tobit|12:19: All these days I did appear to you; but I did neither eat nor drink, but you did see a vision.
live.tobit|12:20: Now therefore give Yahuah (God) thanks: for I go up to him that sent me; but write all things which are done in a book.
live.tobit|12:21: And when they arose, they saw him no more.
live.tobit|12:22: Then they confessed the great and wonderful works of Yahuah (God), and how the angel of Yahuah (God) had appeared to them.
live.tobit|13:1: Then Tobit wrote a prayer of rejoicing, and said, Blessed be Yahuah (God) that lives for ever, and blessed be his kingdom.
live.tobit|13:2: For he does scourge, and has mercy: he leadeth down to hell, and brings up again: neither is there any that can avoid his hand.
live.tobit|13:3: Confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for he has scattered us among them.
live.tobit|13:4: There declare his greatness, and extol him before all the living: for he is our Elohim (God), and he is Yahuah (God) our Father for ever.
live.tobit|13:5: And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.
live.tobit|13:6: If you turn to him with your whole heart, and with your whole mind, and deal uprightly before him, then will he turn to you, and will not hide his face from you. Therefore see what he will do with you, and confess him with your whole mouth, and praise Yahuah (God) of might, and extol the everlasting King. In the land of my captivity do I praise him, and declare his might and majesty to a sinful nation. O you sinners, turn and do justice before him: who can tell if he will accept you, and have mercy on you?
live.tobit|13:7: I will extol my Elohim (God), and my soul shall praise the King of heaven, and shall rejoice in his greatness.
live.tobit|13:8: Let all men speak, and let all praise him for his righteousness.
live.tobit|13:9: O Jerusalem, the holy city, he will scourge you for your children’s works, and will have mercy again on the sons of the righteous.
live.tobit|13:10: Give praise to Yahuah (God), for he is good: and praise the everlasting King, that his tabernacle may be builded in you again with joy, and let him make joyful there in you those that are captives, and love in you for ever those that are miserable.
live.tobit|13:11: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands, even gifts to the King of heaven; all generations shall praise you with great joy.
live.tobit|13:12: Cursed are all they which hate you, and blessed shall all be which love you for ever.
live.tobit|13:13: Rejoice and be glad for the children of the just: for they shall be gathered together, and shall bless Yahuah (God) of the just.
live.tobit|13:14: O blessed are they which love you, for they shall rejoice in your peace: blessed are they which have been sorrowful for all your scourges; for they shall rejoice for you, when they have seen all your glory, and shall be glad for ever.
live.tobit|13:15: Let my soul bless Yahuah (God) the great King.
live.tobit|13:16: For Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone: your walls and towers and battlements with pure gold.
live.tobit|13:17: And the streets of Jerusalem shall be paved with beryl and carbuncle and stones of Ophir.
live.tobit|13:18: And all her streets shall say, Alleluia; and they shall praise him, saying, Blessed be Yahuah (God), which has extolled it for ever.
live.tobit|14:1: So Tobit made an end of praising Yahuah (God).
live.tobit|14:2: And he was eight and fifty years old when he lost his sight, which was restored to him after eight years: and he gave alms, and he increased in the fear of Yahuah (God), and praised him.
live.tobit|14:3: And when he was very aged he called his son, and the sons of his son, and said to him, My son, take your children; for, behold, I am aged, and am ready to depart out of this life.
live.tobit|14:4: Go into Media my son, for I surely believe those things which Jonas the prophet spoke of Nineve, that it shall be overthrown; and that for a time peace shall rather be in Media; and that our brothers shall lie scattered in the earth from that good land: and Jerusalem shall be desolate, and the house of Yahuah (God) in it shall be burned, and shall be desolate for a time;
live.tobit|14:5: And that again Yahuah (God) will have mercy on them, and bring them again into the land, where they shall build a temple, but not like to the first, until the time of that age be fulfilled; and afterward they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem gloriously, and the house of Yahuah (God) shall be built in it for ever with a glorious building, as the prophets have spoken thereof.
live.tobit|14:6: And all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols.
live.tobit|14:7: So shall all nations praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people; and all those which love Yahuah (God) in truth and justice shall rejoice, shewing mercy to our brothers.
live.tobit|14:8: And now, my son, depart out of Nineve, because that those things which the prophet Jonas spoke shall surely come to pass.
live.tobit|14:9: But keep you the law and the commandments, and shew thyself merciful and just, that it may go well with you.
live.tobit|14:10: And bury me decently, and your mother with me; but tarry no longer at Nineve. Remember, my son, how Aman handled Achiacharus that brought him up, how out of light he brought him into darkness, and how he rewarded him again: yet Achiacharus was saved, but the other had his reward: for he went down into darkness. Manasses gave alms, and escaped the snares of death which they had set for him: but Aman fell into the snare, and perished.
live.tobit|14:11: Wherefore now, my son, consider what alms doeth, and how righteousness does deliver. When he had said these things, he gave up the ghost in the bed, being an hundred and eight and fifty years old; and he buried him honourably.
live.tobit|14:12: And when Anna his mother was dead, he buried her with his father. But Tobias departed with his wife and children to Ecbatane to Raguel his father in law,
live.tobit|14:13: Where he became old with honour, and he buried his father and mother in law honourably, and he inherited their substance, and his father Tobit’s.
live.tobit|14:14: And he died at Ecbatane in Media, being an hundred and seven and twenty years old.
live.tobit|14:15: But before he died he heard of the destruction of Nineve, which was taken by Nabuchodonosor and Assuerus: and before his death he rejoiced over Nineve.
live.judith|1:1: In the twelfth year of the reign of Nabuchodonosor, who reigned in Nineve, the great city; in the days of Arphaxad, which reigned over the Medes in Ecbatane,
live.judith|1:2: And built in Ecbatane walls round about of stones hewn three cubits broad and six cubits long, and made the height of the wall seventy cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits:
live.judith|1:3: And set the towers thereof upon the gates of it an hundred cubits high, and the breadth thereof in the foundation threescore cubits:
live.judith|1:4: And he made the gates thereof, even gates that were raised to the height of seventy cubits, and the breadth of them was forty cubits, for the going forth of his mighty armies, and for the setting in array of his footmen:
