cards.note: Psalm 2:12 — *Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.* Honouring wisdom that the kings may reign for evermore (Wisdom of Solomon 6:21) is the Psalm's homage to the Son that the rulers perish not.
cards.s_text: If your delight be then in thrones and sceptres, O you kings of the people, honour wisdom, that you may reign for evermore.
cards.t_text: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

cards.note: Psalm 2:10 — *Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.* Wisdom of Solomon 6:9 speaks the second Psalm's very summons — the kings and judges of the earth called to learn wisdom and not fall away.
cards.s_text: To you therefore, O kings, do I speak, that you may learn wisdom, and not fall away.
cards.t_text: Be wise now therefore, O you kings: be instructed, you judges of the earth.

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:17 — *And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear.* The strict reckoning of the mighty in Wisdom of Solomon 6:6 is Kepha's impartial Father judging every man's work.
cards.s_text: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.
cards.t_text: And if you call on the Father, who without respect of persons judges according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

cards.note: Romans 2:11 — *For there is no respect of persons with God.* Sha'ul states plainly what Wisdom of Solomon 6:7 declares — the God over all stands in awe of no man's greatness.
cards.s_text: For he which is Yahuah (God) over all shall fear no man’s person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man’s greatness: for he has made the small and great, and careth for all alike.
cards.t_text: For there is no respect of persons with Elohim (God).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 1:17 — *Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man: for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.* Wisdom of Solomon 6:7 voices the Torah's own rule that the Judge who made small and great fears no man's greatness.
cards.s_text: For he which is Yahuah (God) over all shall fear no man’s person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man’s greatness: for he has made the small and great, and careth for all alike.
cards.t_text: You shall not respect persons in judgment; but you shall hear the small as well as the great; you shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is Elohim's (God’s): and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

cards.note: Psalm 66:7 — *He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.* The ministers of His kingdom in Wisdom of Solomon 6:4 who kept not the law are the rebellious whom the all-beholding King will not let exalt themselves.
cards.s_text: Because, being ministers of his kingdom, you have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of Yahuah (God);
cards.t_text: He rules by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

cards.note: Daniel 2:21 — *And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding.* The same Giver of sovereignty in Wisdom of Solomon 6:3 is the One who removes kings and bestows wisdom on the ruler who seeks it.
cards.s_text: For power is given you of Yahuah (God), and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.
cards.t_text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and sets up kings: he gives wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

cards.note: Romans 13:1 — *Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.* Sha'ul echoes Wisdom of Solomon 6:3 — every authority is a delegated stewardship granted of Yahuah, never self-owned.
cards.s_text: For power is given you of Yahuah (God), and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.
cards.t_text: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of Elohim (God): the powers that be are ordained of Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 1:24 — *But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).* The Wisdom against whom *vice shall not prevail* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:30) is the Messiah, the power and wisdom of Elohim.
cards.s_text: For after this comes night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom.
cards.t_text: But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).

cards.note: John 1:9 — *That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.* The Wisdom *more beautiful than the sun... found before* the light (Wisdom of Solomon 7:29) is the true Light of the Logos.
cards.s_text: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.
cards.t_text: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that comes into the world.

cards.note: John 1:5 — *And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.* Wisdom, who *being compared with the light, she is found before it*, and against whom *vice shall not prevail* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:29–30), is John's Light the darkness cannot overcome.
cards.s_text: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.
cards.t_text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

cards.note: John 1:4 — *In him was life; and the life was the light of men.* The Wisdom who *makes all things new* and enters holy souls (Wisdom of Solomon 7:27) is the life and light of John's Logos.
cards.s_text: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah (God), and prophets.
cards.t_text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 8:1 — *Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.* The continuation of Solomon's own hymn: the *one* who *makes all things new* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:27) orders all things end to end.
cards.s_text: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah (God), and prophets.
cards.t_text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 24:8 — *So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* Wisdom entering *holy souls* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:27) is the same Wisdom given her inheritance in Israel.
cards.s_text: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah (God), and prophets.
cards.t_text: So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 24:3 — *I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.* Sirach's self-praising Wisdom is the same *one* who *can do all things* in Wisdom of Solomon 7:27 — a deuterocanon self-link.
cards.s_text: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah (God), and prophets.
cards.t_text: I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The *brightness of the everlasting light* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:26) is the glory beheld when the Word took flesh.
cards.s_text: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:2 — *Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;* the *breath of the power... flowing from the glory of the Almighty* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:25) is the Son by whom the worlds were made.
cards.s_text: For she is the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.
cards.t_text: Has in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

cards.note: Colossians 1:15 — *Who is the image of the invisible Elohim (God), the firstborn of every creature:* Wisdom is *the image of his goodness* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:26); Messiah is the image of the invisible Elohim.
cards.s_text: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.
cards.t_text: Who is the image of the invisible Elohim (God), the firstborn of every creature:

cards.note: Hebrews 1:3 — *Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;* the exact triad of Wisdom of Solomon 7:26 — *brightness*, *image*, upholding all — fulfilled in the Son.
cards.s_text: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.
cards.t_text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

cards.note: Colossians 1:17 — *And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.* Wisdom *passeth and goes through all things* (Wisdom of Solomon 7:24) — the same all-pervading sustaining the NT names in Messiah.
cards.s_text: For wisdom is more moving than any motion: she passeth and goes through all things by reason of her pureness.
cards.t_text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

cards.note: Proverbs 8:30 — *Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;* the Formed Wisdom of Proverbs stands behind the *worker of all things* of Wisdom of Solomon 7:22.
cards.s_text: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,
cards.t_text: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

cards.note: Colossians 1:16 — *For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:* the creating Wisdom of Solomon 7:22 is the Messiah by whom all was made.
cards.s_text: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,
cards.t_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* Wisdom of Solomon 7:22 calls her *the worker of all things* — the same agency John ascribes to the Word.
cards.s_text: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 1:24 — *But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).* The wisdom Solomon prayed for in Wisdom of Solomon 7:7 is unveiled in the NT as a Person, the Messiah.
cards.s_text: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
cards.t_text: But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).

cards.note: James 1:5 — *If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.* The same covenant pattern Wisdom of Solomon 7:7 models — ask, and the spirit of wisdom is given.
cards.s_text: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
cards.t_text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that gives to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

cards.note: 1 Kings 3:12 — *Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.* The granting in 1 Kings is the answer to the prayer Wisdom of Solomon 7:7 voices — wisdom *came to me*.
cards.s_text: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
cards.t_text: Behold, I have done according to your words: lo, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like unto you.

cards.note: 1 Kings 3:9 — *Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?* Wisdom of Solomon 7:7 retells in the first person the very prayer Solomon prayed at Gibeon.
cards.s_text: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
cards.t_text: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:19 — *And incorruption makes us near to Yahuah (God):* Solomon's plea to obtain Wisdom as the gift of Elohim in 8:21 reaches toward the incorruption that 6:19 says brings the seeker near to Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except Yahuah (God) gave her me; and that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was; I prayed to Yahuah (God), and besought him, and with my whole heart I said,
cards.t_text: And incorruption makes us near to Yahuah (God):

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The alliance with wisdom that is immortality in 8:17 is grounded in the prophetic promise of resurrection to everlasting life.
cards.s_text: Now when I considered these things in myself, and pondered them in my heart, how that to be allied to wisdom is immortality;
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* The immortality Wisdom secures in 8:13 is the same resurrection hope of chapter 3, the righteous kept safe in Elohim's hand.
cards.s_text: Moreover by the means of her I shall obtain immortality, and leave behind me an everlasting memorial to them that come after me.
cards.t_text: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 9:9 — *And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.* The prayer Solomon begins in 8:21 unfolds in chapter 9, confessing that Wisdom was present at creation and knows Yahuah's commandments.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except Yahuah (God) gave her me; and that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was; I prayed to Yahuah (God), and besought him, and with my whole heart I said,
cards.t_text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 24:4 — *I dwelt in high places, and my throne is in a cloudy pillar.* The Wisdom who foresees signs, wonders, and the events of seasons in 8:8 is the same enthroned heavenly Wisdom of Sirach 24, surveying the times from on high.
cards.s_text: If a man desire much experience, she knoweth things of old, and conjectureth aright what is to come: she knoweth the subtilties of speeches, and can expound dark sentences: she foreseeth signs and wonders, and the events of seasons and times.
cards.t_text: I dwelt in high places, and my throne is in a cloudy pillar.

cards.note: James 1:5 — *If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.* The wisdom that knows things of old and what is to come in 8:8 is the gift James says is freely given to any who ask Elohim.
cards.s_text: If a man desire much experience, she knoweth things of old, and conjectureth aright what is to come: she knoweth the subtilties of speeches, and can expound dark sentences: she foreseeth signs and wonders, and the events of seasons and times.
cards.t_text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that gives to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

cards.note: 1 Kings 3:12 — *Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.* The virtues Wisdom imparts in 8:7 are the wise and understanding heart Yahuah granted Solomon above all men.
cards.s_text: And if a man love righteousness her labours are virtues: for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life.
cards.t_text: Behold, I have done according to your words: lo, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like unto you.

cards.note: 1 Kings 3:9 — *Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?* The justice and prudence Wisdom teaches in 8:7 is the very discerning heart Solomon asked of Yahuah at Gibeon.
cards.s_text: And if a man love righteousness her labours are virtues: for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life.
cards.t_text: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?

cards.note: Colossians 2:3 — *In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.* The mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah to which Wisdom is privy in 8:4 are the treasures hid in Messiah.
cards.s_text: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah (God), and a lover of his works.
cards.t_text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 1:24 — *But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).* The Wisdom privy to the mysteries of Elohim in 8:4 is named the wisdom of Elohim — Messiah Himself.
cards.s_text: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah (God), and a lover of his works.
cards.t_text: But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 24:8 — *So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* The Wisdom conversant with Yahuah in 8:3 is given her dwelling among the covenant people — election kept, not a church replacing Israel.
cards.s_text: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah (God), and a lover of his works.
cards.t_text: So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 24:3 — *I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.* The Wisdom privy to the mysteries of Yahuah in 8:4 is the same who in Sirach proceeds from the mouth of the Most High to fill the earth.
cards.s_text: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah (God), and a lover of his works.
cards.t_text: I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:18 — *And love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed to her laws is the assurance of incorruption;* The love of Wisdom that Solomon professes in 8:2 is defined within the same book as the keeping of her laws — Torah-fidelity, not mere affection.
cards.s_text: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.
cards.t_text: And love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed to her laws is the assurance of incorruption;

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 6:12 — *Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yes, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.* The youth who sought her out and loved her beauty in 8:2 is the lover whom 6:12 promises will easily find her.
cards.s_text: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.
cards.t_text: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yes, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.

cards.note: Proverbs 4:8 — *Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.* The bride imagery of 8:2 — loving her beauty and embracing her — is the Proverbs promise that embracing Wisdom brings honour.
cards.s_text: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.
cards.t_text: Exalt her, and she shall promote you: she shall bring you to honour, when you do embrace her.

cards.note: Proverbs 4:6 — *Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.* Solomon's desire to make Wisdom his spouse in 8:2 is the Proverbs charge to love her so that she preserves and keeps the one who holds her.
cards.s_text: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.
cards.t_text: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve you: love her, and she shall keep you.

cards.note: Colossians 1:16 — *For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:* The Wisdom who ordereth all things sweetly in 8:1 is the One by whom and for whom all things were made.
cards.s_text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
cards.t_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Wisdom reaching from end to end and ordering all things in 8:1 is named by John as the Word who was with Elohim and was Elohim.
cards.s_text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Proverbs 8:30 — *Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;* The Wisdom that sweetly orders all things in 8:1 is the same craftsman who was beside Yahuah ordering creation from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
cards.t_text: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:26 — *For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.* The reaching, ordering Wisdom of 8:1 is the radiance and image of Elohim — the formed Wisdom the NT names the Word.
cards.s_text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
cards.t_text: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 7:25 — *For she is the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.* The wisdom who orders all things end-to-end in 8:1 is the same breath of Elohim's power, so her sweet governance is the operation of the divine Logos.
cards.s_text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
cards.t_text: For she is the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.

cards.note: Proverbs 3:6 — *In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.* Wisdom 9:18 — men's ways reformed and saved through wisdom — is the directed path of the one who acknowledges Yahuah in all his ways.
cards.s_text: For so the ways of them which lived on the earth were reformed, and men were taught the things that are pleasing to you, and were saved through wisdom.
cards.t_text: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct your paths.

cards.note: John 16:13 — *Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.* The Spirit sent from above to teach (Wisdom 9:17) is the Spirit of truth who guides into all truth.
cards.s_text: And your counsel who has known, except you give wisdom, and send your Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) from above?
cards.t_text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 2:10 — *But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.* Wisdom 9:17 — that none knows Yahuah's counsel unless He sends the Ruach HaKodesh — is exactly the Spirit who searches the deep things of Elohim.
cards.s_text: And your counsel who has known, except you give wisdom, and send your Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) from above?
cards.t_text: But Elohim (God) has revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of Elohim (God).

cards.note: John 3:12 — *If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?* Wisdom 9:16 — that the things in heaven none has searched out — is the very gap Messiah names to Nicodemus.
cards.s_text: And hardly do we guess aright at things that are upon earth, and with labour do we find the things that are before us: but the things that are in heaven who has searched out?
cards.t_text: If I have told you earthly things, and you believe not, how shall you believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

cards.note: Romans 11:34 — *For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?* Paul's doxology echoes Wisdom 9:13 — no mortal can know the counsel of Yahuah apart from His own revealing.
cards.s_text: For what man is he that can know the counsel of Yahuah (God)? or who can think what the will of Yahuah (God) is?
cards.t_text: For who has known the mind of Yahuah (Lord)? or who has been his counsellor?

cards.note: Isaiah 40:13 — *Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?* Solomon's question — what man can know the counsel of Yahuah (Wisdom 9:13) — is Isaiah's challenge to the mind that would counsel its Maker.
cards.s_text: For what man is he that can know the counsel of Yahuah (God)? or who can think what the will of Yahuah (God) is?
cards.t_text: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD), or being his counsellor has taught him?

cards.note: John 3:13 — *And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.* Wisdom sent down from the throne of glory (Wisdom 9:10) matches the descent of the Son who alone brings heavenly things.
cards.s_text: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.
cards.t_text: And no man has ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of Adam which is in heaven.

cards.note: Proverbs 2:6 — *For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.* Solomon's plea to have wisdom sent from the holy heavens (Wisdom 9:10) rests on Yahuah being the sole giver of wisdom.
cards.s_text: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.
cards.t_text: For Yahuah (LORD) gives wisdom: out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

cards.note: Colossians 1:16 — *For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him.* The wisdom present at creation in 9:9 is the One in whom and for whom all things were made.
cards.s_text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
cards.t_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* Wisdom 9:9 — wisdom knowing the works and present at the world's making — is the Logos through whom all was made.
cards.s_text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: Proverbs 8:30 — *Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him.* Wisdom present when Yahuah made the world (Wisdom 9:9) is the formed Wisdom rejoicing beside Him in Proverbs 8.
cards.s_text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
cards.t_text: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

cards.note: James 1:5 — *If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.* Wisdom 9:6 — that the perfect man is nothing without wisdom — is why James commands the lacking to ask the giving Elohim.
cards.s_text: For though a man be never so perfect among the children of men, yet if your wisdom be not with him, he shall be nothing regarded.
cards.t_text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that gives to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

cards.note: 2 Chronicles 1:10 — *Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?* Solomon's confession of being too young for judgment (Wisdom 9:5) is answered by this Chronicles prayer for wisdom to govern.
cards.s_text: For I your servant and son of yours handmaid am a feeble person, and of a short time, and too young for the understanding of judgment and laws.
cards.t_text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this your people, that is so great?

cards.note: 1 Kings 3:9 — *Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?* Solomon's plea for throne-wisdom in Wisdom 9:4 is the same petition for a discerning heart at Gibeon.
cards.s_text: Give me wisdom, that sits by your throne; and reject me not from among your children:
cards.t_text: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?

cards.note: Jubilees 48:14 — *And all the peoples whom he brought to pursue after Yashar'el (Israel), Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar'el (Israel), even as the people of Egypt had cast their children into the river. He took vengeance on 1,000,000 of them, and one thousand strong and energetic men were destroyed on account of one suckling of the children of your people which they had thrown into the river.* The now-live Jubilees self-links Wisdom who *drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep* (10:19).
cards.s_text: But she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep.
cards.t_text: And all the peoples whom he brought to pursue after Yashar’el (Israel), Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar’el (Israel), even as the people of Egypt had cast their children into the river. He took vengeance on 1,000,000 of them, and one thousand strong and energetic men were destroyed on account of one suckling of the children of your people which they had thrown into the river.

cards.note: Psalm 105:37 — *He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.* This is the *reward of their labours* Wisdom rendered to the righteous (10:17), the providence over the fathers.
cards.s_text: Rendered to the righteous a reward of their labours, guided them in a marvellous way, and was to them for a cover by day, and a light of stars in the night season;
cards.t_text: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

cards.note: Exodus 14:22 — *And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.* This is Wisdom that *brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water* (10:18).
cards.s_text: Brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water:
cards.t_text: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

cards.note: Jubilees 39:3 — *And he set Joseph over all his house, and the blessing of Yahuah (God) came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph, and Yahuah (God) prospered him in all that he did.* The now-live Jubilees self-links Wisdom who *delivered him from sin* and went down into the pit (10:13).
cards.s_text: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,
cards.t_text: And he set Joseph over all his house, and the blessing of Yahuah (God) came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph, and Yahuah (God) prospered him in all that he did.

cards.note: Genesis 41:40 — *Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.* This is *the sceptre of the kingdom* Wisdom brought him out of bonds (10:14).
cards.s_text: And left him not in bonds, till she brought him the sceptre of the kingdom, and power against those that oppressed him: as for them that had accused him, she shewed them to be liars, and gave him perpetual glory.
cards.t_text: You shall be over my house, and according unto your word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than you.

cards.note: Genesis 39:3 — *And his master saw that Yahuah (LORD) was with him, and that Yahuah (LORD) made all that he did to prosper in his hand.* This is Wisdom who *forsook him not* when the righteous was sold (10:13).
cards.s_text: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,
cards.t_text: And his master saw that Yahuah (LORD) was with him, and that Yahuah (LORD) made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

cards.note: Genesis 28:15 — *And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.* This is Wisdom guiding Jacob *in right paths* and keeping him through the flight (10:10).
cards.s_text: When the righteous fled from his brother’s wrath she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of Yahuah (God), and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.
cards.t_text: And, behold, I am with you, and will keep you in all places whither you go, and will bring you again into this land; for I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken to you of.

cards.note: Genesis 28:13 — *And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham thy father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.* This is the *kingdom of Yahuah (God)* Wisdom *shewed him* when the righteous fled (10:10).
cards.s_text: When the righteous fled from his brother’s wrath she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of Yahuah (God), and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.
cards.t_text: And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac: the land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your seed;

cards.note: *When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.* (Wisdom of Solomon 10:6). *And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom.* (Jubilees 16:6). Jubilees goes on in the next verse to tell how Lot was saved because Elohim (God) remembered Abraham and sent him out of the midst of the overthrow; Wisdom names the same deliverance from the other side — the righteous man delivered from the fire that fell on the five cities. The judgment on Sodom and the rescue of the righteous out of it are one act, told in both books.
cards.s_text: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.
cards.t_text: And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom.

cards.note: Genesis 19:26 — *But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.* This is *a standing pillar of salt... a monument of an unbelieving soul* (10:7).
cards.s_text: Of whose wickedness even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.
cards.t_text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

cards.note: Genesis 19:24 — *Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven.* This is *the fire which fell down upon the five cities*, from which Wisdom *delivered the righteous man* Lot (10:6).
cards.s_text: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.
cards.t_text: Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;

cards.note: Hebrews 11:8 — *By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.* This is *the righteous... preserved blameless* whom Wisdom *found out* amid the confounded nations (10:5).
cards.s_text: Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded, she found out the righteous, and preserved him blameless to Yahuah (God), and kept him strong against his tender compassion toward his son.
cards.t_text: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:22 — *And Noah made the ark in all respects as He commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the fifth week in the fifth year (on the new moon of the first month).* The now-live Jubilees self-links Wisdom's *piece of wood* (10:4) to the dated building of the ark.
cards.s_text: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.
cards.t_text: And Noah made the ark in all respects as He commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the fifth week in the fifth year (on the new moon of the first month).

cards.note: Hebrews 11:7 — *By faith Noah, being warned of Elohim (God) of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.* The ark of *small value* (10:4) is the saving of the righteous house by faith.
cards.s_text: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.
cards.t_text: By faith Noah, being warned of Elohim (God) of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

cards.note: Genesis 7:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.* This is *the righteous* whose course Wisdom *directed... in a piece of wood of small value* (10:4).
cards.s_text: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Noah, Come you and all your house into the ark; for you have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

cards.note: Genesis 4:8 — *And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.* This is *the fury with which he murdered his brother* (10:3) — the unrighteous who *went away from her in his anger*.
cards.s_text: But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury with which he murdered his brother.
cards.t_text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

cards.note: Genesis 1:28 — *And Elohim (God) blessed them, and Elohim (God) said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.* The dominion Wisdom *gave him power to rule all things* (10:2) is the garden mandate given to the first-formed father.
cards.s_text: And gave him power to rule all things.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) blessed them, and Elohim (God) said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moves upon the earth.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 18:13 — *The mercy of man is toward his neighbour; but the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.* Ben Sira's mercy upon all flesh is the same lover-of-souls confession Wisdom of Solomon 11:26 makes.
cards.s_text: But you sparest all: for they are yours, O Yahuah (God), you lover of souls.
cards.t_text: The mercy of man is toward his neighbour; but the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.

cards.note: Ezekiel 18:32 — *For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.* The God who takes no pleasure in death is the lover of souls who spares all in Wisdom of Solomon 11:26.
cards.s_text: But you sparest all: for they are yours, O Yahuah (God), you lover of souls.
cards.t_text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dies, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): wherefore turn yourselves, and live you.

cards.note: Jonah 4:11 — *And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?* Yahuah's plea to spare Nineveh enacts Wisdom of Solomon 11:24's truth that He abhors nothing He has made.
cards.s_text: For you lovest all the things that are, and abhorrest nothing which you have made: for never wouldest you have made any thing, if you had hated it.
cards.t_text: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

cards.note: Psalms 145:9 — *Yahuah (LORD) is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.* David's mercy over all His works is the very confession of Wisdom of Solomon 11:23-24, that He loves all He has made.
cards.s_text: But you have mercy upon all; for you can do all things, and winkest at the sins of men, because they should amend.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 18:11 — *Therefore is Yahuah (God) patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them.* Ben Sira draws the same conclusion Wisdom of Solomon 11:22-23 draws — the world's smallness is the ground of His patience and outpoured mercy.
cards.s_text: For the whole world before you is as a little grain of the balance, yes, as a drop of the morning dew that falls down upon the earth.
cards.t_text: Therefore is Yahuah (God) patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them.

cards.note: Ecclesiasticus 18:10 — *As a drop of water to the sea, and a gravelstone in comparison of the sand; so are a thousand years to the days of eternity.* Ben Sira's drop-and-gravelstone matches Wisdom of Solomon 11:22's grain of the balance and drop of dew — creation is nothing beside the Eternal.
cards.s_text: For the whole world before you is as a little grain of the balance, yes, as a drop of the morning dew that falls down upon the earth.
cards.t_text: As a drop of water to the sea, and a gravelstone in comparison of the sand; so are a thousand years to the days of eternity.

cards.note: Isaiah 40:12 — *Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?* Isaiah's measuring, meting, and weighing is the cosmic order Wisdom of Solomon 11:20 names as measure and number and weight.
cards.s_text: Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.
cards.t_text: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

cards.note: Job 28:25 — *To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.* Job's wisdom-poem gives the same weighing and measuring Wisdom of Solomon 11:20 ascribes to the Creator who ordered all things.
cards.s_text: Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.
cards.t_text: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

cards.note: Exodus 7:20 — *And Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.* The perpetual river troubled with foul blood in Wisdom of Solomon 11:6 is the first plague turning the Nile to blood.
cards.s_text: For instead of a perpetual running river troubled with foul blood,
cards.t_text: And Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 10:4 — *And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).* Paul names the Rock Wisdom of Solomon 11:4 remembers — the wilderness draught was Messiah Himself.
cards.s_text: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.
cards.t_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: Numbers 20:11 — *And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.* The water out of the hard stone in Wisdom of Solomon 11:4 is the Meribah gift, given abundantly to the thirsty congregation.
cards.s_text: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.
cards.t_text: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

cards.note: Exodus 17:6 — *Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).* The Horeb rock is the very flinty stone Wisdom of Solomon 11:4 says quenched their thirst.
cards.s_text: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.
cards.t_text: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb; and you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 14:27 — *For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.* Solomon's coming idolatry-polemic self-links: the "own abominations" that torment men in Wisdom 12:23 are idols, named the source and end of all evil.
cards.s_text: Wherefore, whereas men have lived dissolutely and unrighteously, you have tormented them with their own abominations.
cards.t_text: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.

cards.note: Romans 1:23 — *And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.* Those in Wisdom 12:27 who "denied to know" the true Yahuah are Romans 1's people who exchanged his glory — the deliberate refusal that brings damnation.
cards.s_text: For, look, for what things they grudged, when they were punished, that is, for them whom they thought to be gods; now being punished in them, when they saw it, they acknowledged him to be the true Yahuah (God), whom before they denied to know: and therefore came extreme damnation upon them.
cards.t_text: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

cards.note: Romans 1:23 — *And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.* Paul's idolatry indictment — exchanging the Creator for beast-images — is exactly the error Wisdom 12:24 names, men holding for gods what is despised among the beasts.
cards.s_text: For they went astray very far in the ways of error, and held them for gods, which even among the beasts of their enemies were despised, being deceived, as children of no understanding.
cards.t_text: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

cards.note: Luke 6:36 — *Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.* Wisdom 12:22 grounds our mercy in God's goodness so that "when we ourselves are judged, we should look for mercy" — imitating the Father's own mercy.
cards.s_text: Therefore, whereas you do chasten us, you scourgest our enemies a thousand times more, to the intent that, when we judge, we should carefully think of your goodness, and when we ourselves are judged, we should look for mercy.
cards.t_text: Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

cards.note: Matthew 5:7 — *Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.* Wisdom 12:19 — God's works teach that "the just man should be merciful" — is the Beatitude's exact logic: mercy extended draws mercy received.
cards.s_text: But by such works have you taught your people that the just man should be merciful, and have made your children to be of a good hope that you give repentance for sins.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 11:23 — *But you have mercy upon all; for you can do all things, and winkest at the sins of men, because they should amend.* Solomon's own prior verse self-links: omnipotence is bent toward amendment, the same hope Wisdom 12:19 gives God's children.
cards.s_text: But by such works have you taught your people that the just man should be merciful, and have made your children to be of a good hope that you give repentance for sins.
cards.t_text: But you have mercy upon all; for you can do all things, and winkest at the sins of men, because they should amend.

cards.note: 1 Timothy 2:4 — *Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.* The God who gives repentance for sins in Wisdom 12:19 is the God whose will Paul says reaches toward all.
cards.s_text: But by such works have you taught your people that the just man should be merciful, and have made your children to be of a good hope that you give repentance for sins.
cards.t_text: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

cards.note: Ezekiel 18:23 — *Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and not that he should return from his ways, and live?* The "good hope" of repentance in Wisdom 12:19 rests on this — God's pleasure is the sinner's return, not his death.
cards.s_text: But by such works have you taught your people that the just man should be merciful, and have made your children to be of a good hope that you give repentance for sins.
cards.t_text: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

cards.note: 2 Peter 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.* Peter names the very purpose of the "time and place" Wisdom 12:20 says God grants the condemned.
cards.s_text: For if you did punish the enemies of your children, and the condemned to death, with such deliberation, giving them time and place, by which they might be delivered from their malice:
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Romans 9:20 — *Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against Elohim (God)? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?* Paul silences the same protest Wisdom 12:12 forecloses — none may say "What have you done?" to the Judge of all.
cards.s_text: For who shall say, What have you done? or who shall withstand your judgment? or who shall accuse you for the nations that perish, whom you made? or who shall come to stand against you, to be revenged for the unrighteous men?
cards.t_text: Nay but, O man, who are you that repliest against Elohim (God)? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why have you made me thus?

cards.note: Psalm 145:9 — *Yahuah (LORD) is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.* Wisdom 12:16 — being Elohim of all makes him gracious to all — is this Psalm in argument form.
cards.s_text: For your power is the beginning of righteousness, and because you are Yahuah (God) of all, it makes you to be gracious to all.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

cards.note: Isaiah 45:5 — *I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God) beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:* The sole-Elohim confession of Wisdom 12:13 echoes Isaiah's repeated "none else."
cards.s_text: For neither is there any Yahuah (God) but you that careth for all, to whom you might shew that your judgment is not unright.
cards.t_text: I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God) beside me: I girded you, though you have not known me:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 4:35 — *Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God); there is none else beside him.* Wisdom 12:13's "no Elohim but thou" is the Shema's exclusivity restated as the ground of righteous judgment.
cards.s_text: For neither is there any Yahuah (God) but you that careth for all, to whom you might shew that your judgment is not unright.
cards.t_text: Unto you it was shewed, that you might know that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God); there is none else beside him.

cards.note: Romans 2:4 — *Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of Elohim (God) leadeth thee to repentance?* Paul names the principle Wisdom 12:10 dramatizes — the withheld stroke is goodness aimed at turning the sinner.
cards.s_text: But executing your judgments upon them by little and little, you gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.
cards.t_text: Or despisest you the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of Elohim (God) leads you to repentance?

cards.note: Deuteronomy 9:4 — *Speak not thou in thine heart, after that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness Yahuah (LORD) hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah (LORD) doth drive them out from before thee.* The judgment in Wisdom 12:10 falls on a "naughty generation" for its own wickedness, never as Israel's merit.
cards.s_text: But executing your judgments upon them by little and little, you gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.
cards.t_text: Speak not you in your heart, after that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has cast them out from before you, saying, For my righteousness Yahuah (LORD) has brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah (LORD) does drive them out from before you.

cards.note: Exodus 23:30 — *By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.* Wisdom 12:8-10 lifts Torah's exact phrase "by little and little" and reads its restraint as room for repentance.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless even those you sparedst as men, and did send wasps, forerunners of yours host, to destroy them by little and little.
cards.t_text: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until you be increased, and inherit the land.

cards.note: Exodus 23:29 — *I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.* The very Torah word Wisdom 12:8 is reading — the dispossession deliberately measured, not total at once.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless even those you sparedst as men, and did send wasps, forerunners of yours host, to destroy them by little and little.
cards.t_text: I will not drive them out from before you in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against you.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 14:8 — *But that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it; and it, because, being corruptible, it was called god.* The next breath of the same polemic — the dead thing of Wisdom 13:18, *that which is weak... that which is dead*, named cursed along with its maker.
cards.s_text: For health he calls upon that which is weak: for life prayeth to that which is dead; for aid humbly beseecheth that which has least means to help: and for a good journey he asketh of that which cannot set a foot forward:
cards.t_text: But that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it; and it, because, being corruptible, it was called god.

cards.note: Psalm 115:5 — *They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:* The lifeless idol Wisdom 13:17 prays to — speaking *to that which has no life.*
cards.s_text: Then makes he prayer for his goods, for his wife and children, and is not ashamed to speak to that which has no life.
cards.t_text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

cards.note: Psalm 115:4 — *Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.* The very *gold and silver... the works of men's hands* that Wisdom 13:10 calls a dead hope.
cards.s_text: But miserable are they, and in dead things is their hope, who call them gods, which are the works of men’s hands, gold and silver, to shew art in, and resemblances of beasts, or a stone good for nothing, the work of an ancient hand.
cards.t_text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

cards.note: Jeremiah 10:3 — *For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.* Jeremiah's felled tree is Wisdom 13:11's carpenter *that felleth timber* — the vain custom of carving gods from the forest.
cards.s_text: Now a carpenter that felleth timber, after he has sawn down a tree meet for the purpose, and taken off all the bark skilfully round about, and has wrought it handsomely, and made a vessel thereof fit for the service of man’s life;
cards.t_text: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

cards.note: Isaiah 44:16 — *He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:* The same refuse Wisdom 13:12 burns *to dress his meat* — and the residue becomes a god.
cards.s_text: And after spending the refuse of his work to dress his meat, has filled himself;
cards.t_text: He burns part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eats flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

cards.note: Isaiah 44:13 — *The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.* Isaiah's carpenter is Wisdom 13:13's — carving the leftover wood *to the image of a man.*
cards.s_text: And taking the very refuse among those which served to no use, being a crooked piece of wood, and full of knots, has carved it diligently, when he had nothing else to do, and formed it by the skill of his understanding, and fashioned it to the image of a man;
cards.t_text: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

cards.note: Romans 1:25 — *Who changed the truth of Elohim (God) into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.* The unpardonable swap of Wisdom 13:8-9 — serving the creature, having failed to find the Creator thereof.
cards.s_text: For if they were able to know so much, that they could aim at the world; how did they not sooner find out Yahuah (God) thereof?
cards.t_text: Who changed the truth of Elohim (God) into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

cards.note: Acts 17:29 — *Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of Elohim (God), we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.* The answer to Wisdom 13:9's reproach — those able to *aim at the world* should have found its God, not graven him in gold and stone.
cards.s_text: For if they were able to know so much, that they could aim at the world; how did they not sooner find out Yahuah (God) thereof?
cards.t_text: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of Elohim (God), we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by are and man’s device.

cards.note: Acts 17:27 — *That they should seek Yahuah (Lord), if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:* Paul names the very groping after God that Wisdom 13:6 calls the lesser error — men *seeking Yahuah (God), and desirous to find him.*
cards.s_text: But yet for this they are the less to be blamed: for they perhaps err, seeking Yahuah (God), and desirous to find him.
cards.t_text: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

cards.note: Job 12:7 — *But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:* Even the creatures testify to him that made them, the very inference Wisdom 13:4 demands — to understand the mightier one by his power and virtue.
cards.s_text: But if they were astonished at their power and virtue, let them understand by them, how much mightier he is that made them.
cards.t_text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach you; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell you:

cards.note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The same creation-preaching that Wisdom 13:5 makes the ground of the idolater's guilt.
cards.s_text: For by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen.
cards.t_text: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.

cards.note: Romans 1:20 — *For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:* Romans quotes Wisdom 13:5 — the maker *proportionably seen* in the beauty of the creatures, leaving the idolater without excuse.
cards.s_text: For by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen.
cards.t_text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

cards.note: Romans 1:21 — *Because that, when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.* Paul's *became vain* is Wisdom 13:1's *vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God)* — the same failure to acknowledge the workmaster.
cards.s_text: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God), and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;
cards.t_text: Because that, when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

cards.note: Romans 12:19 — *Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.* Paul claims the same 'just vengeance' that Wisdom of Solomon 14:31 assigns to God against the ungodly, forbidding the believer to take it up himself.
cards.s_text: For it is not the power of them by whom they swear: but it is the just vengeance of sinners, that punishes always the offence of the ungodly.
cards.t_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says Yahuah (Lord).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 32:35 — *To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.* The 'just vengeance of sinners' that always punishes the ungodly in Wisdom of Solomon 14:31 is the vengeance God reserves to Himself in the Song of Moses.
cards.s_text: For it is not the power of them by whom they swear: but it is the just vengeance of sinners, that punishes always the offence of the ungodly.
cards.t_text: To me belongs vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

cards.note: Exodus 20:7 — *Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.* The false swearing 'in deceit, despising holiness' punished in Wisdom of Solomon 14:30 breaks the third commandment, which will not hold the swearer guiltless.
cards.s_text: Howbeit for both causes shall they be justly punished: both because they thought not well of Yahuah (God), giving heed to idols, and also unjustly swore in deceit, despising holiness.
cards.t_text: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain; for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.

cards.note: Psalms 115:8 — *They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.* The lifeless idols in which men trust in Wisdom of Solomon 14:29 are the Psalmist's dumb images that make their trusters like themselves.
cards.s_text: For insomuch as their trust is in idols, which have no life; though they swear falsely, yet they look not to be hurt.
cards.t_text: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusts in them.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 13:1 — *Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God), and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;* the thesis that idolatry is *the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil* (Wisdom of Solomon 14:27) completes the polemic begun in 13:1, the Creator unknown though seen — the very pairing Romans 1:20 and 1:25 draw on.
cards.s_text: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.
cards.t_text: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God), and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;

cards.note: Romans 1:26 — *For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:* The 'changing of kind... disorder in marriages... shameless uncleanness' of Wisdom of Solomon 14:26 is precisely the vile affections against nature in Romans 1:26.
cards.s_text: Disquieting of good men, forgetfulness of good turns, defiling of souls, changing of kind, disorder in marriages, adultery, and shameless uncleanness.
cards.t_text: For this cause Elohim (God) gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

cards.note: Romans 1:24 — *Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:* The defiled lives and marriages of Wisdom of Solomon 14:24 are the uncleanness God gives idolaters up to in Romans 1:24.
cards.s_text: They kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled: but either one slew another traiterously, or grieved him by adultery.
cards.t_text: Wherefore Elohim (God) also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

cards.note: Romans 1:29 — *Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,* Paul's vice-list of murder, deceit and unrighteousness is the same 'blood, manslaughter, theft... perjury' that reigns after idolatry in Wisdom of Solomon 14:25.
cards.s_text: So that there reigned in all men without exception blood, manslaughter, theft, and dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, tumults, perjury,
cards.t_text: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

cards.note: Romans 1:28 — *And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;* Paul's reprobate mind is exactly the company who 'erred in the knowledge of Yahuah (God)' in Wisdom of Solomon 14:22 — Romans 1 is quoting this idolatry polemic.
cards.s_text: Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of Yahuah (God); but whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance, those so great plagues called they peace.
cards.t_text: And even as they did not like to retain Elohim (God) in their knowledge, Elohim (God) gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

cards.note: Acts 19:25 — *Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.* Demetrius the silversmith rallies the craftsmen of beautiful images, the same artificer's allure that makes the ignorant multitude idolaters in Wisdom of Solomon 14:20.
cards.s_text: And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god, which a little before was but honoured.
cards.t_text: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, you know that by this craft we have our wealth.
