cards.t_text: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.note: Luke 13:24 — *Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.* Those who labour not to enter the strait things can never receive what is laid up, exactly as Yahusha warns of the many who shall not be able.
cards.s_text: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.
cards.t_text: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

cards.note: Matthew 7:14 — *Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.* The one-man path between fire and water is Yahusha's narrow way that few find.
cards.s_text: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.
cards.t_text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.

cards.note: Matthew 7:13 — *Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:* The broad way to destruction is Esdras's wide door of the present world that brings not life.
cards.s_text: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:
cards.t_text: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

cards.note: 2 Timothy 1:9 — *Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) before the world began,* The few to whom the wonders are shewn in 8:62 are kept by purpose and grace, election before works.
cards.s_text: These things have I not shewed to all men, but to you, and a few like you. Then answered I and said,
cards.t_text: Who has saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) before the world began,

cards.note: Matthew 22:14 — *For many are called, but few are chosen.* The 'few like you' to whom alone these things are shewed (8:62) are the chosen few of the Messiah's word.
cards.s_text: These things have I not shewed to all men, but to you, and a few like you. Then answered I and said,
cards.t_text: For many are called, but few are chosen.

cards.note: 2 Timothy 1:10 — *But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:* The 'treasure of immortality' shewed in the end (8:54) is brought to light through the Besorah.
cards.s_text: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.
cards.t_text: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who has abolished death, and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

cards.note: Revelation 21:4 — *And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.* The passing of sorrows in 2 Esdras 8:54 is John's wiping away of all tears.
cards.s_text: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

cards.note: Revelation 22:2 — *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* John sees planted in the builded city the very tree of life Esdras names in 8:52.
cards.s_text: For to you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yes, perfect goodness and wisdom.
cards.t_text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

cards.note: Luke 23:43 — *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.* The paradise Esdras says is 'opened' to the lowly is the paradise the Messiah opens from the tree to the thief in 8:52.
cards.s_text: For to you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yes, perfect goodness and wisdom.
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Verily I say unto you, To day shall you be with me in paradise.

cards.note: *In that you have humbled thyself, as it becometh you, and have not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.* (2 Esdras 8:49). *I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.* (Luke 18:14). The Most High tells Ezra that what is marvellous in him is that he humbled himself and did not judge himself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous. The publican in the temple does the same, standing afar off and asking for mercy, and he goes home justified while the one who exalted himself does not. The rule Yahusha (Jesus) states, that the humble are exalted, is the rule by which Ezra is commended. Ezra's not counting himself worthy is exactly what the Most High counts worthy.
cards.s_text: In that you have humbled thyself, as it becometh you, and have not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.
cards.t_text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

cards.note: Luke 18:13 — *And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, Elohim (God) be merciful to me a sinner.* The publican who dares not be glorified is the very humility for which Esdras is commended in 8:49.
cards.s_text: In that you have humbled thyself, as it becometh you, and have not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.
cards.t_text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, Elohim (God) be merciful to me a sinner.

cards.note: Psalm 143:2 — *And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.* David, like Esdras in 8:32, flees judgment-by-works and pleads to be counted among those who have no works of righteousness but mercy.
cards.s_text: For if you have a desire to have mercy upon us, you shall be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.
cards.t_text: And enter not into judgment with your servant: for in your sight shall no man living be justified.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 7:20 — *For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.* The Preacher's 'not a just man upon earth' is precisely 2 Esdras 8:35's 'no man... but he has dealt wickedly.'
cards.s_text: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he has dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which has not done amiss.
cards.t_text: For there is not a just man upon earth, that does good, and sins not.

cards.note: Psalm 139:14 — *I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.* The fearful, wonderful making of the body answers the great labour with which 2 Esdras 8:8 says the creature is fashioned.
cards.s_text: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and you give it members, your creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months does your workmanship endure your creature which is created in her.
cards.t_text: I will praise you; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are your works; and that my soul knows right well.

cards.note: Psalm 139:13 — *For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.* David's covering in the womb is Esdras's creature fashioned and preserved nine months in the mother's womb.
cards.s_text: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and you give it members, your creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months does your workmanship endure your creature which is created in her.
cards.t_text: For you have possessed my reins: you have covered me in my mother’s womb.

cards.note: Isaiah 65:17 — *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.* The age Esdras calls 'the world to come' is Isaiah's new heavens and new earth.
cards.s_text: And he answered me, saying, The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few.
cards.t_text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

cards.note: Matthew 22:14 — *For many are called, but few are chosen.* The Messiah's epigram says in one line what 2 Esdras 8:3 says of the many created but the few saved.
cards.s_text: There be many created, but few shall be saved.
cards.t_text: For many are called, but few are chosen.

cards.note: *And he answered me, saying, The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few.* (2 Esdras 8:1). *Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:* (Matthew 7:13). Ezra is told that this world was made for many and the world to come for few. Yahusha (Jesus) draws the same two ways on the ground: a wide gate and a broad way crowded with the many, and a strait gate that few find (Matthew 7:14). The many of the broad way are the many of this world; the few of the narrow way are the few of the world to come. The numbers match because the two men are describing the same thing.
cards.s_text: And he answered me, saying, The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few.
cards.t_text: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

cards.note: Isaiah 54:1 — *Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith Yahuah (LORD).* The barren one who *had no child* in 2 Esdras 9:43 is the desolate Tziyon bidden to sing, for her children shall outnumber the married wife's.
cards.s_text: She said to me, I your servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,
cards.t_text: Sing, O barren, you that did not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you that did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: 1 Samuel 1:10 — *And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), and wept sore.* The woman who did nothing *but make my prayer to the Highest* day and night in 2 Esdras 9:44 is Hannah in bitterness of soul, weeping sore at Shiloh.
cards.s_text: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.
cards.t_text: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), and wept sore.

cards.note: 1 Samuel 1:11 — *And she vowed a vow, and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto Yahuah (LORD) all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.* The handmaid whom *Yahuah heard* and gave a son after thirty years of prayer in 2 Esdras 9:45 is Hannah, who vowed and was remembered.
cards.s_text: After thirty years Yahuah (God) heard me yours handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour to the Almighty.
cards.t_text: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), if you will indeed look on the affliction of your handmaid, and remember me, and not forget your handmaid, but will give unto your handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto Yahuah (LORD) all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

cards.note: Hebrews 8:10 — *For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel) after those days, saith Yahuah (Lord); I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a Elohim (God), and they shall be to me a people:* That the law *perishes not, but remains in his force* in 2 Esdras 9:37 is confirmed where the covenant writes the same law on mind and heart.
cards.s_text: Notwithstanding the law perishes not, but remains in his force.
cards.t_text: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel) after those days, says Yahuah (Lord); I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a Elohim (God), and they shall be to me a people:

cards.note: Jeremiah 31:33 — *But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.* The law *sown in you* that brings fruit forever in 2 Esdras 9:31 is the same law written upon the inward parts in the new covenant.
cards.s_text: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and you shall be honoured in it for ever.
cards.t_text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: Matthew 13:8 — *But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.* The law that the Holy One says He will *sow in you, and it shall bring fruit* in 2 Esdras 9:31 is the seed that bears fruit in the good ground of Yahusha's parable.
cards.s_text: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and you shall be honoured in it for ever.
cards.t_text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

cards.note: Romans 11:1 — *I say then, Hath Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.* The perishing of the multitude in 2 Esdras 9:22 is not Israel cast away, for the grape — the elect remnant — is kept.
cards.s_text: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
cards.t_text: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.note: Romans 11:5 — *Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.* The grape kept while the multitude perishes in 2 Esdras 9:22 is Sha'ul's remnant according to the election of grace.
cards.s_text: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
cards.t_text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

cards.note: Isaiah 5:2 — *And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.* The Holy One who *kept me a grape of the cluster* in 2 Esdras 9:21 is the husbandman of Isaiah's vineyard who sought His grapes.
cards.s_text: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
cards.t_text: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

cards.note: Isaiah 5:7 — *For the vineyard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and the men of Yahudah (Judah) his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.* The *plant of a great people* kept in 2 Esdras 9:21 is Isaiah's pleasant plant, the two houses of Yashar'el and Yahudah.
cards.s_text: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
cards.t_text: For the vineyard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and the men of Yahudah (Judah) his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The pitiful case of those who abused His ways and *dwell in torments* in 2 Esdras 9:9 is Daniel's waking to shame and everlasting contempt.
cards.s_text: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Luke 16:25 — *But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.* Ezra's ones who had *liberty* and *place of repentance* yet despised it are Abraham's son who had his good things in his lifetime, in 2 Esdras 9:11.
cards.s_text: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open to them, understood not, but despised it;
cards.t_text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that you in your lifetime receivedst your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and you are tormented.

cards.note: Luke 16:23 — *And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.* Those who despised the law and *must know it after death by pain* in 2 Esdras 9:12 are the rich man lifting up his eyes in torment.
cards.s_text: The same must know it after death by pain.
cards.t_text: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and sees Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

cards.note: James 2:17 — *Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.* The very pairing Ezra makes — escape *by his works, and by faith* — is James's living faith that bears works, in 2 Esdras 9:8.
cards.s_text: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.
cards.t_text: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.

cards.note: Matthew 7:21 — *Not every one that saith unto me, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* Ezra's salvation *by his works, and by faith* is Yahusha's doer of the Father's will, not the mere confessor, in 2 Esdras 9:7.
cards.s_text: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, by which you have believed,
cards.t_text: Not every one that says unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that does the will of my Father which is in heaven.

cards.note: Matthew 7:14 — *Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.* The few who *escape by his works, and by faith* in 2 Esdras 9:7 are the few that find the narrow way to life.
cards.s_text: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, by which you have believed,
cards.t_text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.

cards.note: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* The manifest end with its plain beginning and ending of 2 Esdras 9:5 is Daniel's time of trouble whose deliverance is for the written remnant.
cards.s_text: For like as all that is made in the world has a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:
cards.t_text: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

cards.note: Matthew 24:14 — *And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.* As the Highest will *begin to visit the world* once the signs are read, so the end comes only after the witness is borne in 2 Esdras 9:2.
cards.s_text: Then shall you understand, that it is the very same time, in which the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.
cards.t_text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

cards.note: Matthew 24:7 — *For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.* The earthquakes and uproars of the peoples that mark Ezra's hour are the very birth-pangs Yahusha names before the visitation of 2 Esdras 9:3.
cards.s_text: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:
cards.t_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

cards.note: Baruch 5:1 — *Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that comes from Yahuah (God) for ever.* The empty field where the Highest begins to shew his city (2 Esdras 10:53) is Baruch's Jerusalem stripping off mourning for the glory that comes from Yahuah for ever — the deuterocanon's own grief-to-glory turn.
cards.s_text: Therefore I commanded you to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.
cards.t_text: Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that comes from Yahuah (God) for ever.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:10 — *For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is Elohim (God).* The city no man's building can stand in, shewn only by the Highest (2 Esdras 10:54), is the city with foundations whose builder and maker is Elohim that Abraham awaited.
cards.s_text: For in the place in which the Highest begins to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.
cards.t_text: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is Elohim (God).

cards.note: Isaiah 66:8 — *Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.* The barren Sion who bears in 2 Esdras 10:45 is Isaiah's Zion who travails and brings forth a nation at once.
cards.s_text: Whereas, I say, she said to you, that she has been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years in which there was no offering made in her.
cards.t_text: Who has heard such a thing? who has seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

cards.note: Galatians 4:27 — *For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.* Paul reads the barren-who-bears, the same figure as Sion in 2 Esdras 10:46, as the Jerusalem above bringing forth her children.
cards.s_text: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.
cards.t_text: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren that bear not; break forth and cry, you that travailest not: for the desolate has many more children than she which has an husband.

cards.note: Isaiah 54:1 — *Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith Yahuah (LORD).* The barren who at last bare a son in 2 Esdras 10:46 is Isaiah's barren Zion whose children outnumber the married wife's.
cards.s_text: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.
cards.t_text: Sing, O barren, you that did not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you that did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Tobit 13:16 — *For Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone: your walls and towers and battlements with pure gold.* The comeliness of the city's beauty shewn Ezra in 2 Esdras 10:50 is Tobit's own jeweled, rebuilt Jerusalem — the deuterocanon self-witnessing the New Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: For now the Most High seeth that you are grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from your whole heart for her, so has he shewed you the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:
cards.t_text: For Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone: your walls and towers and battlements with pure gold.

cards.note: Hebrews 12:22 — *But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,* The woman who is Sion in 2 Esdras 10:44 is the heavenly Jerusalem the faithful are come unto in Hebrews.
cards.s_text: This woman, whom you sawest is Sion: and whereas she said to you, even she whom you see as a city builded,
cards.t_text: But you are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

cards.note: Revelation 21:11 — *Having the glory of Elohim (God): and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;* The brightness of her glory and comeliness of her beauty shewn Ezra in 2 Esdras 10:50 is the jasper-clear glory of John's holy city.
cards.s_text: For now the Most High seeth that you are grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from your whole heart for her, so has he shewed you the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:
cards.t_text: Having the glory of Elohim (God): and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

cards.note: Galatians 4:26 — *But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.* The mourning mother whose face shines and is unveiled as a city (2 Esdras 10:25) is Paul's Jerusalem above, the mother of us all.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.
cards.t_text: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

cards.note: Revelation 21:9 — *And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.* The angel-guided vision of the woman-become-city in 2 Esdras 10:27 matches the angel who shews John the bride who is the city.
cards.s_text: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,
cards.t_text: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.

cards.note: Revelation 21:2 — *And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.* The city builded that shews itself from the foundations in 2 Esdras 10:27 is John's holy city descending as a bride.
cards.s_text: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,
cards.t_text: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

cards.note: Revelation 21:4 — *And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.* The rest and ease from labour the Highest gives the mourner in 2 Esdras 10:24 is the final wiping-away of every tear in the New Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: And therefore shake off your great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful to you again, and the Highest shall give you rest and ease from your labour.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

cards.note: Isaiah 66:13 — *As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.* Ezra's counsel that she shall receive her son and be commended (2 Esdras 10:16) is the LORD's own comfort, mother-tender, gathered up in Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: For if you shall acknowledge the determination of Yahuah (God) to be just, you shall both receive your son in time, and shall be commended among women.
cards.t_text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

cards.note: Psalm 137:4 — *How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?* Ezra's grounded psaltery and silenced song in 2 Esdras 10:23 is the exile's hung-up harp by the rivers of Babylon.
cards.s_text: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion has now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.
cards.t_text: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?

cards.note: Lamentations 2:6 — *And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: Yahuah (LORD) hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.* The silenced song and put-out candlestick of 2 Esdras 10:22 is Jeremiah's forgotten feasts and silenced assembly of Zion.
cards.s_text: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;
cards.t_text: And he has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he has destroyed his places of the assembly: Yahuah (LORD) has caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

cards.note: Lamentations 1:1 — *How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!* The widowed solitary city is the very desolation Ezra catalogues in 2 Esdras 10:22.
cards.s_text: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;
cards.t_text: How does the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

cards.note: Daniel 7:27 — *And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon (most High), whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.* When the eagle vanishes and the earth is refreshed (2 Esdras 11:46), the dominion passes to the saints of the Most High in Daniel's everlasting kingdom.
cards.s_text: That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from your violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her.
cards.t_text: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon (most High), whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

cards.note: Daniel 7:26 — *But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.* The Lion's verdict that the fourth beast's time ends through it (2 Esdras 11:39) is Daniel's seated judgment stripping the beast of its dominion.
cards.s_text: Art not you it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?
cards.t_text: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.

cards.note: Revelation 17:14 — *These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.* The Lion who confronts the eagle (2 Esdras 11:37) overthrows the beast-system just as the Lamb overcomes the kings who war against him.
cards.s_text: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice to the eagle, and said,
cards.t_text: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is the Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

cards.note: Revelation 5:5 — *And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.* The roaring lion who sends a man's voice against the eagle (2 Esdras 11:37) is the Messiah-Lion of Judah, Yahusha enthroned to judge the kingdom-of-man.
cards.s_text: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice to the eagle, and said,
cards.t_text: And one of the elders says unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

cards.note: Daniel 7:25 — *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* The head ruling with much oppression (2 Esdras 11:32) wears the face of Daniel's little horn that grinds the saints and presumes to change the times and law.
cards.s_text: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.
cards.t_text: And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

cards.note: Daniel 7:7 — *After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.* The head that put the whole earth in fear (2 Esdras 11:32) is Daniel's dreadful fourth beast that devours and tramples.
cards.s_text: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.
cards.t_text: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

cards.note: Revelation 17:12 — *And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.* The eagle's wings that rise and reign and appear no more (2 Esdras 11:23) are the same short-lived kings John numbers as the ten horns.
cards.s_text: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.
cards.t_text: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

cards.note: Revelation 17:9 — *And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.* The eagle's three heads (2 Esdras 11:23) belong to the same head-counting apocalyptic that John's angel reads as kings and mountains.
cards.s_text: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.
cards.t_text: And here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

cards.note: Revelation 13:7 — *And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.* The beast's power over all nations matches the eagle whom no creature upon earth dares speak against (2 Esdras 11:6).
cards.s_text: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject to her, and no man spoke against her, no, not one creature upon earth.
cards.t_text: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

cards.note: Daniel 7:23 — *Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.* The eagle to whom all things under heaven are subject (2 Esdras 11:6) is Daniel's whole-earth-devouring fourth kingdom.
cards.s_text: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject to her, and no man spoke against her, no, not one creature upon earth.
cards.t_text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

cards.note: Revelation 13:1 — *And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.* John's beast and Ezra's eagle both ascend from the sea, the kingdom-of-man surfacing out of the nations.
cards.s_text: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.
cards.t_text: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

cards.note: Daniel 7:3 — *And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.* The eagle of 2 Esdras 11:1 rises from the same sea as Daniel's four beasts, the same vision of empire reworked for Ezra.
cards.s_text: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.
cards.t_text: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

cards.note: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The day of judgment spoken from the beginning in 2 Esdras 12:34 is John's great white throne, where the books are opened and the dead are judged.
cards.s_text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
cards.t_text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The coming day of judgment in 2 Esdras 12:34 is Daniel's awakening of the sleepers in the dust to everlasting life or contempt.
cards.s_text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Daniel 12:9 — *And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.* The secrets taught only to the wise who can keep them in 2 Esdras 12:38 are Daniel's words closed and sealed for the latter days.
cards.s_text: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts you know may comprehend and keep these secrets.
cards.t_text: And he said, Go your way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

cards.note: Daniel 12:4 — *But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.* The charge to write the vision in a book and hide it in 2 Esdras 12:37 echoes Daniel's sealing of the words until the time of the end.
cards.s_text: Therefore write all these things that you have seen in a book, and hide them:
cards.t_text: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:* The rest of the people the Anointed makes joyful in 2 Esdras 12:34 are the two sticks joined into one nation under one King.
cards.s_text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Isaiah 11:12 — *And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* The mercy shown to the rest of the people in 2 Esdras 12:34 gathers both houses — outcast Israel and dispersed Judah — from the four corners.
cards.s_text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
cards.t_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:11 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.* The rest of the people delivered with mercy in 2 Esdras 12:34 is the remnant Yahuah recovers a second time from the lands of the dispersion.
cards.s_text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: 2 Thessalonians 2:8 — *And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom Yahuah (Lord) shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:* The Anointed who reproves and corrects the wicked kingdoms in 2 Esdras 12:33 is the One who consumes the Wicked with the breath of his mouth at his coming.
cards.s_text: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
cards.t_text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

cards.note: Daniel 7:27 — *And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon (most High), whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.* After the Anointed sets the kingdoms before him in judgment in 2 Esdras 12:33, the dominion passes to the saints of the Most High.
cards.s_text: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
cards.t_text: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon (most High), whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

cards.note: Daniel 7:11 — *I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.* The whole body of the eagle burnt in 2 Esdras 12:3 is Daniel's beast slain and given to the burning flame — the same end of the kingdom of man.
cards.s_text: And I saw, and, behold, they appeared no more, and the whole body of the eagle was burnt so that the earth was in great fear: then awaked I out of the trouble and trance of my mind, and from great fear, and said to my spirit,
cards.t_text: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

cards.note: Revelation 13:1 — *And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.* The kingdom feared above all that rose up from the sea in 2 Esdras 12:13 is John's many-headed beast risen from the same sea — the kingdom-system of man.
cards.s_text: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.
cards.t_text: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

cards.note: Daniel 7:23 — *Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.* The angel ties the eagle from the sea directly to Daniel's brother-vision in 2 Esdras 12:11 — both name the fourth, devouring kingdom of man.
cards.s_text: The eagle, whom you sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of your brother Daniel.
cards.t_text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

cards.note: Revelation 5:5 — *And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.* The lion rising out of the wood and roaring against the eagle in 2 Esdras 12:31 is the very Lion of the tribe of Judah who prevails in John's throne-vision.
cards.s_text: And the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which you have heard;
cards.t_text: And one of the elders says unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

cards.note: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The Anointed kept unto the end of 2 Esdras 12:32 is Shiloh, in whom the sceptre of Judah comes to rest and the people are gathered.
cards.s_text: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
cards.t_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

cards.note: Genesis 49:9 — *Yahudah (Judah) is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?* The roaring lion that rebukes the eagle is the whelp of Judah of Jacob's blessing, the Anointed sprung from David's tribe of 2 Esdras 12:32.
cards.s_text: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
cards.t_text: Yahudah (Judah) is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, you are gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

cards.note: Hosea 1:10 — *Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God).* Those found within his borders, defended in that day, are the once-disowned reclaimed as sons of the living Elohim.
cards.s_text: But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.
cards.t_text: Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, You are the sons of the living Elohim (God).

cards.note: Romans 11:1 — *I say then, Hath Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.* The Son defending his people that remain is Paul's witness that Elohim has not cast away his people.
cards.s_text: Now when he destroys the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.
cards.t_text: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.note: Jeremiah 31:8 — *Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.* The Highest staying the stream so the tribes may pass through is the great company Yahuah brings home from the north country.
cards.s_text: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.
cards.t_text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

cards.note: Hosea 1:11 — *Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.* The peaceable multitude gathered to the Son is Judah and Israel gathered together under one head.
cards.s_text: And whereas you sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude to him;
cards.t_text: Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* The ten tribes led captive by Assyria are the divided kingdom Ezekiel sees made one nation under one king.
cards.s_text: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Isaiah 11:12 — *And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* The peaceable multitude returning with peace is the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah assembled from the four corners.
cards.s_text: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.
cards.t_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:11 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.* The ten tribes carried beyond the river and now beginning to come are the remnant Yahuah recovers a second time from Assyria.
cards.s_text: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: Revelation 7:9 — *After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.* Zion shewed to all men, prepared and builded without hands, is where John's innumerable multitude stands before the Lamb.
cards.s_text: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as you sawest the hill graven without hands.
cards.t_text: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

cards.note: Psalms 2:6 — *Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.* The Son standing on the top of mount Sion is the King the Father sets upon his holy hill.
cards.s_text: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.
cards.t_text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

cards.note: Revelation 19:15 — *And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of El Shaddai (Almighty God).* The Man who holds no instrument of war is John's rider whose sword proceeds from his mouth to smite the nations.
cards.s_text: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:
cards.t_text: And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treads the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of El Shaddai (Almighty God).

cards.note: 2 Thessalonians 2:8 — *And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom Yahuah (Lord) shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming.* The Son destroying the wicked without labour by the law like fire is the Lord consuming the Wicked with the spirit of his mouth.
cards.s_text: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments with which they shall begin to be tormented, which are like to a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like to fire.
cards.t_text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

cards.note: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* The blast of fire and flaming breath from the Man's mouth is Isaiah's Branch slaying the wicked with the breath of his lips.
cards.s_text: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Psalms 2:7 — *I will declare the decree: Yahuah (LORD) hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.* The One whom the Highest has kept a great season to deliver his creature is the begotten Son of the decree.
cards.s_text: The same is he whom Yahuah (God) the Highest has kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.
cards.t_text: I will declare the decree: Yahuah (LORD) has said unto me, You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.

cards.note: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* When the Son is declared as the man ascending, the everlasting kingdom Daniel saw given to the Son of Adam is his.
cards.s_text: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed you before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom you sawest as a man ascending.
cards.t_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Ezra's Man waxing strong with the thousands of heaven is Daniel's Son of Adam coming with the clouds, before whom all things tremble.
cards.s_text: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: Revelation 22:19 — *And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim (God) shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.* The Word published "that the worthy and unworthy may read it" is sealed against subtraction as well as addition.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spoke, saying, The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
cards.t_text: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim (God) shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

cards.note: Revelation 22:18 — *For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim (God) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:* The openly-published Word is the canon that may be neither added to nor diminished.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spoke, saying, The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
cards.t_text: For I testify unto every man that hears the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim (God) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

cards.note: Matthew 13:11 — *He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* "These words shall you declare, and these shall you hide" is the Master's own pattern of mysteries entrusted to the wise.
cards.s_text: These words shall you declare, and these shall you hide.
cards.t_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 31:26 — *Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that it may be there for a witness against thee.* The seventy books reserved beside the public canon echo the law-book kept by the ark as a witness.
cards.s_text: But keep the seventy last, that you may deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:
cards.t_text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that it may be there for a witness against you.

cards.note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The kept-alive who obtain mercy and whose names are made manifest are the wise who shine in Daniel's rising.
cards.s_text: Therefore if so be that you will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, you shall be kept alive and after death you shall obtain mercy.
cards.t_text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* Esdras's "after death... when we shall live again" with the righteous made manifest and the ungodly declared is Daniel's resurrection to life or to contempt.
cards.s_text: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: John 4:14 — *But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.* The Ruach HaKodesh Esdras prays into himself to write the Word is this springing well of the Spirit.
cards.s_text: But if I have found grace before you, send the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) into me, and I shall write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in your law, that men may find your path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
cards.t_text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

cards.note: John 7:38 — *He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.* Wisdom growing in Esdras's breast so his mouth pours forth is the river of the Spirit flowing out of the inward man.
cards.s_text: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:
cards.t_text: He that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

cards.note: John 4:14 — *But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.* The cup like water yet like fire, drunk inward, is the living water that becomes a well of understanding within.
cards.s_text: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.
cards.t_text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

cards.note: Psalm 119:89 — *For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), thy word is settled in heaven.* Though the law be burnt on earth, it stands settled in heaven, and so can be restored to men.
cards.s_text: For your law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of you, or the work that shall begin.
cards.t_text: For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), your word is settled in heaven.

cards.note: Jeremiah 36:32 — *Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.* Esdras dictating the restored Word by the Spirit mirrors Jeremiah dictating to Baruch after the fire.
cards.s_text: But if I have found grace before you, send the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) into me, and I shall write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in your law, that men may find your path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
cards.t_text: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.

cards.note: Jeremiah 36:28 — *Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Yahudah (Judah) hath burned.* The burnt-law-rewritten of Esdras is the same mercy Jeremiah received when the king burned the scroll.
cards.s_text: For your law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of you, or the work that shall begin.
cards.t_text: Take you again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Yahudah (Judah) has burned.

cards.note: Acts 1:9 — *And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.* The "my Son" with whom Esdras is to remain was Himself taken up; the translated wait with the ascended Messiah.
cards.s_text: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
cards.t_text: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:5 — *By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).* The not-seeing-death that pleased Elohim is exactly the lot promised Esdras, taken to abide with the Son.
cards.s_text: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
cards.t_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).

cards.note: 2 Kings 2:11 — *And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.* Elijah's bodily taking is the same translation into which Esdras is gathered to remain until the times be ended.
cards.s_text: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

cards.note: Genesis 5:24 — *And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.* Esdras being "taken away from all" without ordinary death is the Enoch translation he himself parallels.
cards.s_text: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
cards.t_text: And Enoch walked with Elohim (God): and he was not; for Elohim (God) took him.

cards.note: Exodus 3:10 — *Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt.* The sending and leading of the people out of Egypt that Esdras recalls is the commission given at the bush.
cards.s_text: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
cards.t_text: Come now therefore, and I will send you unto Pharaoh, that you may bring forth my people the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt.

cards.note: Exodus 3:6 — *Moreover he said, I am the Elohim (God) of thy father, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon Elohim (God).* The One who manifestly revealed Himself to Moses in the bush is the One now revealing Himself to Esdras.
cards.s_text: Then said he to me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself to Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
cards.t_text: Moreover he said, I am the Elohim (God) of your father, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon Elohim (God).

cards.note: Exodus 3:4 — *And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.* Esdras answers "Here am I" with the same words and to the same doubled call that Moses gave.
cards.s_text: And I said, Here am I, Yahuah (God) And I stood up upon my feet.
cards.t_text: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

cards.note: Exodus 3:2 — *And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.* The bush that calls Esdras is the very bush of Horeb, named outright in the next verses.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
cards.t_text: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

cards.note: Revelation 18:24 — *And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.* Asia is judged because 'you had always slain my chosen' — the same charge of the blood of saints found in Babylon.
cards.s_text: If you had not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of yours hands, and saying over their dead, when you were drunken,
cards.t_text: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

cards.note: Revelation 18:6 — *Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.* Yahuah's 'like as you have done to my chosen, even so shall Yahuah do to you' is the lex talionis the seer cries over fallen Babylon.
cards.s_text: Like as you have done to my chosen, says Yahuah (God), even so shall Yahuah (God) do to you, and shall deliver you into mischief
cards.t_text: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she has filled fill to her double.

cards.note: Revelation 18:8 — *Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) who judgeth her.* The widowhood, famine, sword and pestilence Yahuah sends on Asia are the very plagues — death, mourning, famine, burning — that fall on Babylon in one day.
cards.s_text: I will send plagues upon you; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste your houses with destruction and death.
cards.t_text: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) who judges her.

cards.note: Revelation 18:2 — *And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.* The Babylon Ezra's avengers go stedfastly to make afraid is the Babylon the angel cries is fallen, is fallen.
cards.s_text: And they shall go stedfastly to Babylon, and make her afraid.
cards.t_text: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
