2 Esdras 2:43 — *upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted.* The king came in to see the guests and found one without a wedding garment (Matthew 22:11).

Wisdom of Solomon 5:16 — *Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the hand of Yahuah (God).* The man without a wedding garment (Matthew 22:12) has no crown to receive; the kingdom and the crown go to those clothed for the feast.
Ecclesiasticus 17:3 — *made them according to his image.* The image stamped on man is the image the King asks about at Matthew 22:20.
Ecclesiasticus 17:11 — *he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.* The law of life given as heritage is among the things that are Elohim's (God's) at Matthew 22:21.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:23 — *made him to be an image of his own eternity.* Caesar's image is on the coin (Matthew 22:20); the Father's image is on the man who holds it.
Wisdom of Solomon 9:1 — *who have made all things with your word.* Render unto Elohim (God) the things that are his (Matthew 22:21): all things, since he made them all with his word.

2 Maccabees 7:9 — *the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life.* The resurrection confessed in blood; the Sadducees erred, not knowing the power of Elohim (God) (Matthew 22:29).

2 Esdras 7:32 — *the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence.* The dead sleep and wait for the earth to give them back, the resurrection Yahusha (Jesus) defends against the Sadducees (Matthew 22:31).
2 Maccabees 7:23 — *will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again.* The Creator gives breath again; Elohim (God) of the living, not of the dead (Matthew 22:32).

Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* Kept and asleep, not in heaven now — the living Abraham, Isaac and Jacob of Matthew 22:32, held for the resurrection.
Ecclesiasticus 7:30 — *Love him that made you with all your strength.* The Shema the Messiah quotes at Matthew 22:37, carried forward by Sirach.
Ecclesiasticus 17:14 — *he gave every man commandment concerning his neighbour.* The commandment concerning the neighbour is the second great commandment of Matthew 22:39.

Ecclesiasticus 28:2 — *Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you.* Forgiving the hurt is love of neighbour in practice; *thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself* (Matthew 22:39) begins in Leviticus 19:18 with no vengeance and no grudge.

Ecclesiasticus 28:7 — *remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance.* Commandments and covenant held together with no malice; at Matthew 22:40 the law and the prophets hang on love, which gathers them up rather than shrinking them.

Wisdom of Solomon 6:18 — *love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed to her laws is the assurance of incorruption.* The two commandments all the law hangs on (Matthew 22:40) do not replace the law; love is the keeping of it.
Ecclesiasticus 10:14 — *cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.* The thrones changing hands is the rule of Matthew 23:12 written as history.
Ecclesiasticus 3:18 — *The greater you are, the more humble thyself.* He that is greatest shall be your servant (Matthew 23:11).
Ecclesiasticus 7:4 — *Seek not of Yahuah (God) preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honour.* The chief seats loved at Matthew 23:6.
Ecclesiasticus 32:1 — *lift not thyself up, but be among them as one of the rest.* The uppermost rooms at feasts (Matthew 23:6) are the opposite of Sirach's master of the feast.

Wisdom of Solomon 6:4 — *being ministers of his kingdom, you have not judged aright, nor kept the law.* Ministers who have not kept the law are the ones who shut up the kingdom against men (Matthew 23:13).
Ecclesiasticus 23:9 — *neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.* Every oath counts; the graded oaths of Matthew 23:16 are the evasion Sirach's counsel never allowed.
Ecclesiasticus 23:11 — *and if he swear in vain, he shall not be innocent.* No oath is empty — to swear by heaven is to swear by the throne (Matthew 23:22).

Ecclesiasticus 27:14 — *The talk of him that sweareth much makes the hair stand upright.* The much swearing Sirach warns of; at Matthew 23:18 it is a whole system of oaths by the altar and oaths by the gift, binding and not binding.
Ecclesiasticus 1:28 — *come not to him with a double heart.* The clean cup with the foul inside at Matthew 23:25.
Ecclesiasticus 1:29 — *Be not an hypocrite in the sight of men.* Righteousness outward unto men, hypocrisy within, at Matthew 23:28.

Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us.* The inside of the cup full of extortion and excess (Matthew 23:25) is what the day exposes, and pride will have profited nothing.
2 Esdras 1:30 — *I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings.* The King speaks the same words in the same voice over Jerusalem (Matthew 23:37).
2 Esdras 1:32 — *whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah (God).* The same sender says, behold, I send unto you prophets, and some of them ye shall kill (Matthew 23:34).
2 Esdras 1:33 — *Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Your house is desolate.* The King said it in the temple and walked out: your house is left unto you desolate (Matthew 23:38).
2 Esdras 5:1 — *the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.* The same sign: many offended, betraying and hating one another (Matthew 24:10).
2 Esdras 5:4 — *the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day.* The signs in the heavens come after the tribulation of those days (Matthew 24:29).
2 Esdras 5:9 — *all friends shall destroy one another.* Many shall betray one another, and shall hate one another (Matthew 24:10).
2 Esdras 13:32 — *then shall my Son be declared, whom you sawest as a man ascending.* The Son of Adam seen coming in the clouds at Matthew 24:30 is the Son declared after the signs.
2 Esdras 13:39 — *he gathered another peaceable multitude to him.* The elect gathered from the four winds at Matthew 24:31 are the ten tribes the next verse names.
Ecclesiasticus 11:26 — *in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.* Reward according to his ways is the servant found so doing at Matthew 24:46.
Ecclesiasticus 16:14 — *every man shall find according to his works.* Finding according to works is the servant made ruler over all his goods at Matthew 24:47.

Ecclesiasticus 27:4 — *As when one sifteth with a sieve, the refuse remains.* The sifting of the household: the trusted servant's talk and conduct show what he is, and at Matthew 24:51 he is *cut asunder* and given *his portion with the hypocrites*.
Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *in the time of their visitation they shall shine.* The visitation is the lord's coming at Matthew 24:46, and the servant found so doing is the one who shines.
Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *in the time of their visitation they shall shine.* The visitation is the Son of Adam coming in his glory at Matthew 25:31.

Wisdom of Solomon 3:8 — *They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people.* The reign that follows the gathering and sorting of Matthew 25:32 — sheep from goats first, then the saints possess the kingdom.

Wisdom of Solomon 5:5 — *How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints.* The lot among the saints is the kingdom prepared from the foundation of the world (Matthew 25:34), revealed on the day, not assigned on it.

Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 — *Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.* The day the righteous stand in boldness is the day of Matthew 25:41; the fire was prepared for the devil and his angels, and the goats are the unfruitful among the gathered.
Ecclesiasticus 11:21 — *trust in Yahuah (God), and abide in your labour.* Abiding in the labour is what earns well done, thou good and faithful servant at Matthew 25:21.

Ecclesiasticus 51:30 — *Work your work betimes, and in his time he will give you your reward.* The reward comes in his time; at Matthew 25:23 the faithful servant receives it when the master returns, not before.
Ecclesiasticus 22:1 — *A slothful man is compared to a filthy stone.* The *wicked and slothful servant* of Matthew 25:26 — the work left undone is the disgrace.
Ecclesiasticus 33:28 — *Set him to work, as is fit for him: if he be not obedient, put on more heavy fetters..* The servant of Matthew 25:27 was judged for doing nothing with his charge.
2 Esdras 8:1 — *this world for many, but the world to come for few.* The shut door of Matthew 25:10 divides the many who set out from the few found ready.
2 Esdras 8:3 — *There be many created, but few shall be saved.* The bridegroom's I know you not at Matthew 25:12 is the other end of the same sentence.
2 Esdras 7:35 — *the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.* The unprofitable servant of Matthew 25:30 was of the house, and his work did not follow him.

2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:33 — *And the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:* The seat of judgment Esdras sees comes after the old silence of seven days (2 Esdras 7:30), at the judgment of the dead after the reign. The throne of glory of Matthew 25:31-32 comes first, at his coming, where the gathered are sifted, the sheep from the goats. One King, two sittings, the reign between them.
Tobit 4:16 — *Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked.* Two of the King's own measures at the judgment, *I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat* (Matthew 25:35).
Ecclesiasticus 7:32 — *stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected.* The hand stretched to the poor is the measure the King uses at Matthew 25:36.
Ecclesiasticus 4:1 — *make not the needy eyes to wait long.* What the sheep are found to have done at Matthew 25:35.

Ecclesiasticus 29:9 — *Help the poor for the commandment’s sake, and turn him not away.* Mercy as the commandment kept; at Matthew 25:40 what was done *unto one of the least of these my brethren* was done to the King.
Tobit 4:7 — *let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor.* The face not turned from the poor meets the King in the least of his brethren (Matthew 25:40).
1 Maccabees 1:63 — *that they might not profane the holy covenant: so then they died.* The blood of the new covenant (Matthew 26:28) seals the same covenant they died for.

1 Maccabees 2:50 — *be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.* The King gave his life for that covenant; his blood of the new covenant is shed for many (Matthew 26:28).
2 Maccabees 7:36 — *are dead under the covenant of Yahuah (God) of everlasting life.* The covenant the martyrs died under is sealed in the King's blood (Matthew 26:28).

4 Maccabees 6:29 — *we are ready to die rather than transgress the commandments of our fathers.* The Maccabean-seven-brothers' one-voice declaration to Antiochus-Epiphanes — the substantial-ready-to-die-rather-than-transgress-the-commandments substance the wisdom-stream walks-the-prefiguring-pattern-for. The King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) at Matt 26:39 walks-substantively-the-substantial-cup-of-suffering-substance the Tanakh-cup-of-Yahuah-wrath-cluster (Psalm 75:8 + Isaiah 51:17-22 + Jeremiah 25:15-29 + Ezekiel 23:31-34) walks-into-substantively.

4 Maccabees 13:13 — *righteousness won the victory, and gave the crown to her athletes.* The substantial-righteousness-won-the-victory + the prize-of-victory-in-incorruption-everlasting-life substance — the Maccabean-faithful walked-substantively-the-endurance into-the-substantial-resurrection. The King at Matt 26:42's second-Gethsemane-prayer (*thy will be done*) walks the substantial-Formless-Source-and-Formed-Expression-substance — direct-rule-out of Trinitarian-three-co-equal-persons + modalist-collapse + Arian-created-being.

4 Maccabees 13:18 — *they having as it were become a ransom for our nation's sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the ransom-for-our-nation's-sin + propitiation-of-their-death-delivered-Yashar'el (Israel) substance. The King-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-as-the-Pesach-lamb-substance walks-the-substantial-fulfillment at-Matt-26:46 — NOT-the-forensic-substitutionary-juridical-transaction the inherited-Anselmian-Reformation-collapse walks; the substantial-Pesach-lamb-fulfillment + Yom Kippur (Day of Atonement) substance + Isaiah 53's Suffering-Servant-bearing-the-iniquities-of-the-many substance.
Ecclesiasticus 6:1 — *Instead of a friend become not an enemy.* Judas's *Master, is it I?* at Matthew 26:25 with the bargain already made.

Ecclesiasticus 12:16 — *An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw you into a pit.* The enemy with sweet lips is Judas with Hail, master, and a kiss at Matthew 26:49.
Ecclesiasticus 37:2 — *when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy.* *Friend, wherefore art thou come?* (Matthew 26:50) is this grief spoken in the garden.
Ecclesiasticus 2:1 — *My son, if you come to serve Yahuah (God), prepare your soul for temptation.* The watch and pray the sleeping disciples did not keep at Matthew 26:41.
Ecclesiasticus 2:5 — *acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.* Peter's denial and bitter weeping at Matthew 26:75 is the furnace doing its work.

2 Baruch 6:7 (Charles edition seq #3) — *I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat.* The wisdom-stream's heavenly-register articulation of the angel-from-above acting upon the veil — Matt 27:51's veil-rent-from-the-top-to-the-bottom names the operative-fulfillment of the Father-from-above tearing-the-veil-from-the-heavenly-side per Hebrews 10:19-22.

4 Maccabees 15:3 (Charles edition seq #11) — *her seven sons according to the tyrant's promise, loved rather religion, which saveth unto eternal life according to Elohim (God).* The wisdom-stream names the choosing-the-eternal-life-architecture over the present-life-preservation — the King at Matt 27:42 walks-out the same priority at universal-scale: COULD-save-himself per Matt 26:53 + John 10:17-18; chooses the Pesach (Passover)-lamb-substance per the Father's-purpose.

4 Maccabees 7:18-19 (Charles edition seq #6) — *believing that unto Elohim (God) they die not, as our patriarchs, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, died not, but that they live unto Elohim (God).* The wisdom-stream names the patriarchs-sleeping-awaiting-the-first-resurrection architecture per Red Line #11 (Romans 11:24's natural-branches-able-to-be-grafted-in-again); the mockers' challenge at Matt 27:43 is the inverse of the architecture — the deliverance is the resurrection on the third day, not the come-down-from-the-cross.

4 Maccabees 17:13 (Charles edition seq #13) — *for on that day virtue, proving them through endurance, set before them the prize of victory in incorruption in everlasting life.* The wisdom-stream names the endurance-unto-the-prize-of-incorruption architecture — the King's voluntary-yielding-up-of-the-ghost at Matt 27:50 (Greek *aphēken to pneuma*) is the supreme-walking-out per John 10:17-18's *no man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself.*

4 Maccabees 17:18-22 (Charles edition seq #13) — *they having as it were become a ransom for our nation's sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.* THE direct verbal-anchor: the wisdom-stream had named the categorically-exempt-righteous-paying-the-atonement-substance-the-categorically-bound-owed architecture centuries before the cross; the cross walks-it-out at universal-scale per Hebrews 7:27's *this he did once, when he offered up himself.* Read CAREFULLY per the framework's *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* exposition — the cross is the door-home opening (grace as the means of return-to-the-Way), NOT the inherited-Reformation-forensic-substitutionary-juridical-transaction collapse.

Luke carries the substitutionary-atoning-blood architecture with synoptic substance — the King silent before his accusers, the mockery from those who pass by, the *if thou be the King of the Yahudim (Jews), save thyself* (v.37), and the death-as-faithful-unto-death the 4 Maccabees prefiguring names.
2 Esdras 7:30 — *the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days.* The three hours of darkness at Matthew 27:45 were a small showing of that silence.
2 Esdras 7:33 — *the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away.* The veil rent and the earth quaking at Matthew 27:51 carry the marks of that day.

2 Esdras 7:32 — *the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence.* The graves opened and the sleeping saints arose at Matthew 27:52, a first showing of it.

2 Baruch 51:1 (Charles edition seq #21) — *those who have been saved by their works, and to whom the law has been now a hope... shall behold the world which is now invisible to them, and they shall behold the time which is now hidden from them.* The wisdom-stream's resurrection-glory architecture — the saints-arising-and-appearing-in-the-holy-city at Matt 27:53 walks-out the historical-pivot-foretaste. Read the *saved by their works* CAREFULLY — NOT the inherited-Reformation-merit-doctrine collapse; works are the fruit-of-the-Spirit-internalized-Torah per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34 + James 2:14-26.

Luke carries the cosmic-darkness-over-the-land from the sixth to the ninth hour with the synoptic substance, uniquely naming *the sun was darkened* (v.45) — the day-of-the-Most-High substance the 2 Esdras / 2 Baruch witness frames around the cross.
Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *in the time of their visitation they shall shine.* The empty tomb at Matthew 28:6 is the firstfruits of that visitation; the rest sleep and wait.
Wisdom of Solomon 3:8 — *their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever.* The reign of risen saints on the earth, which began with *he is risen* at Matthew 28:6.

Wisdom of Solomon 5:15 — *But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah (God).* The risen body the women held by the feet (Matthew 28:9) is the firstfruits of the righteous living for evermore.

Wisdom of Solomon 5:16 — *a beautiful crown from the hand of Yahuah (God): for with his right hand shall he cover them.* The risen King the women worshipped (Matthew 28:9) is the first of the righteous to receive the kingdom and the crown from the Father's hand.
2 Esdras 13:40 — *he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.* The scattered house lives among the nations, which is why the word goes to all nations (Matthew 28:19).

2 Esdras 13:47 — *stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through.* The Father brings the tribes back; the disciples go to all nations because that is where they were carried (Matthew 28:19).
2 Esdras 4:30 — *how much ungodliness has it brought up to this time?.* The same heart is the ground where Satan takes away the word that was sown (Mark 4:15).

2 Esdras 4:28, 32 — *the evil is sown, but the destruction thereof is not yet come... when the ears shall be cut down... how great a floor shall they fill?* Mark 4:29's *immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come* names the same appointed threshing-floor of the age.
2 Esdras 9:31 — *I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you.* The good ground of Mark 4:20 brings forth the fruit the sown law was given to bring.
Ecclesiasticus 3:7 — *He that fears Yahuah (God) will honour his father.* The commandment the corban tradition severs from the fear of Yahuah (God) at Mark 7:10.
Ecclesiasticus 3:8 — *both in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon you from them.* The deed the tradition forbids at Mark 7:12.
Ecclesiasticus 3:9 — *the blessing of the father establishes the houses of children.* The foundation the tradition of Mark 7:13 roots out.

Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 15:14 — *He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel.* The Hebrew library locates the source of evil in the man's own choosing; Mark 7:20's *that which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man* names the same.

Sirach 27:6 — *The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.* The outward utterance discloses the inward heart; Mark 7:21's *from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts* is the same diagnostic — the fruit declares the tree.

Judith 16:17 — *Yahuah (God) Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever.* The Hebrew library's victory-song pairs the deathless worm with the unquenched fire in the day-of-judgment register; Mark 9:48's *where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched* walks the same Isaiah-66-rooted image.
Ecclesiasticus 31:8 — *Blessed is the rich that is found without blemish, and has not gone after gold..* The rich young ruler of Mark 10:21 was offered that blessing and went away grieved.

Ecclesiasticus 31:5 — *He that loves gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption.* The one Sirach says will not be justified is the one who *hardly* enters the kingdom at Mark 10:23.
Ecclesiasticus 31:6 — *Gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present..* The ruin is in the trusting; *how hard is it for them that trust in riches* (Mark 10:24).
Ecclesiasticus 31:7 — *every fool shall be taken with it.* The one taken by his gold cannot pass the needle's eye of Mark 10:25.
2 Esdras 5:23 — *you have chosen you one only vine.* The vineyard let out to husbandmen at Mark 12:1 was the owner's choice, never the keepers'.
2 Esdras 5:27 — *among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people.* The lord of the vineyard at Mark 12:9 takes back the keeping of a people that was always his.

2 Esdras 5:29 — *they which did gainsay your promises, and believed not your covenants, have trodden them down.* The husbandmen of Mark 12:9 carry the same unbelief inside the hedge, and meet the same owner.

Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God).* Why the fathers are living to the Father — *He is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but the Elohim (God) of the living* (Mark 12:27).

Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope the bush bears witness to at Mark 12:26 — the Elohim (God) of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, long after their burial.
2 Esdras 13:39 — *he gathered another peaceable multitude to him.* The elect gathered from the four winds at Mark 13:27 are the ten tribes the next verse names.

2 Esdras 13:40 — *the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land.* The tribes named by the history of their scattering are the elect the angels gather *from the uttermost part of the earth* (Mark 13:27).
2 Esdras 13:47 — *therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.* The act of the Most High, not the scattered's own contriving; Mark 13:27's elect gathered from the four winds.

Baruch 4:37 — *lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One.* The four-quarters gathering accomplished by the word of the Holy One; Mark 13:27's *gather together his elect from the four winds* walks the same architecture, the gathering of those who were sent away.
Baruch 5:5 — *behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One.* With 4:37 the gathering comes from every direction; the elect from the four winds (Mark 13:27).
Ecclesiasticus 36:11 — *Gather all the tribes of Jacob together.* The elect gathered from the four winds (Mark 13:27) is this prayer answered.

1 Maccabees 1:63 — *they chose rather to die, that they might not... profane the holy covenant: so then they died.* The faithful dying rather than profane the covenant; Mark 14:24's *my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many* names the covenant itself sealed by the King's own blood.
1 Maccabees 2:50 — *give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.* Mark 14:24, the King's blood of the new covenant shed for many, is a life given for that covenant.
2 Maccabees 7:36 — *are dead under the covenant of Yahuah (God) of everlasting life.* Mark 14:24's blood of the new covenant seals the covenant of everlasting life the martyrs died under.
Ecclesiasticus 36:11 — *inherit you them, as from the beginning.* Mary's *he hath holpen his servant Yashar'el (Israel)* (Luke 1:54) is this prayer beginning to be answered.
Ecclesiasticus 36:12 — *have mercy upon the people that is called by your name.* Mercy remembered toward his servant Yashar'el (Israel) in Luke 1:54.
Baruch 4:36 — *look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).* The gathering that keeps the oath to Abraham and his seed for ever (Luke 1:55).
Baruch 4:37 — *your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west.* Abraham's seed for ever, gathered home (Luke 1:55).
Baruch 5:7 — *every high hill, and banks of long continuance, should be cast down, and valleys filled up.* The leveled road is for Yashar'el (Israel) to walk home; John opened it (Luke 3:5).
Baruch 5:9 — *Yahuah (God) shall lead Yashar'el (Israel) with joy in the light of his glory.* Where the road ends; all flesh sees the salvation of Elohim (God) (Luke 3:6).

Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:1 — *Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.* The fire-prophet behind the first contrast case; Luke 4:25-26 names Elias sent not to the many widows of Yashar'el but to the one Tsidonian (Sidonian) widow — individual mercy without absorption.

Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:3 — *By the word of Yahuah (God) he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire.* The heaven-shut famine; Luke 4:25's *when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land* names the same famine as the frame for the individual-mercy contrast.

Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 48:12 — *Eliseus was filled with his spirit.* Eliseus (Elisha) filled with the double-portion spirit — the prophet behind the second contrast case; Luke 4:27 names none of the many lepers in Yashar'el cleansed *saving Naaman the Syrian* — individual mercy to the foreign-origin man without absorption into the seed-of-promise. The contrast case proves the directional non-symmetry the framework holds against the false-inclusion gospel.
2 Esdras 9:31 — *I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you.* The seed is the word of Elohim (God) at Luke 8:11, and the word sown is the law.
2 Esdras 8:41 — *neither does all that is planted take root.* The rock hearers of Luke 8:13 spring up with no root and fall away.
2 Esdras 9:33 — *they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.* The good ground of Luke 8:15 hears the word and keeps it; the fruit is the keeping.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 — *through envy of the devil came death into the world.* The one who let death in is the one Yahusha (Jesus) saw fall like lightning (Luke 10:18).
Ecclesiasticus 10:12 — *The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God).* The heart turned from its Maker is the lawyer lading burdens at Luke 11:46.
Ecclesiasticus 10:13 — *pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination.* The pride that begins sin is the love of the uppermost seats at Luke 11:43.
Ecclesiasticus 21:14 — *The inner parts of a fool are like a broken vessel.* The lawyers who took away the key of knowledge held none themselves (Luke 11:52).
Ecclesiasticus 21:15 — *it displeaseth him, and he casteth it behind his back.* The word cast behind the back, then the key of knowledge taken away from those entering (Luke 11:52).
Ecclesiasticus 11:19 — *I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods.* Sirach's rich man speaks the rich fool's line of Luke 12:19 centuries early.
Ecclesiasticus 11:18 — *waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward.* The hoarder's whole reward is the heap left behind when the soul is required at Luke 12:20.
Tobit 4:9 — *a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.* The alms given now are the bags that wax not old, the treasure that faileth not (Luke 12:33).
Tobit 4:10 — *alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.* The open hand delivers from death; its treasure is in the heavens where no thief approacheth (Luke 12:33).

Ecclesiasticus 29:11 — *Lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High.* The commandment keeper's treasure is the *treasure in the heavens that faileth not* of Luke 12:33, laid up by alms.

Sirach 29:12 — *shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.* The Hebrew library's *storehouse* image; Luke 12:33-34's *treasure in the heavens... for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also* walks the same storehouse-of-treasure architecture at the heavenly level.

Baruch 4:36 — *look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).* Jerusalem's face turned east toward the coming; the scattered children of Yashar'el (Israel) *shall come from the east, and from the west* to sit down in the kingdom (Luke 13:29).

Baruch 4:37 — *Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west.* The sent-away sons coming home, not strangers added; *they shall come from the east, and from the west* (Luke 13:29).

Baruch 5:5 — *Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east.* Jerusalem's own children brought home as children of the kingdom; they come from east and west to sit down in it (Luke 13:29).
Ecclesiasticus 36:11 — *Gather all the tribes of Jacob together.* From east, west, north and south (Luke 13:29) the scattered tribes sit down at home.
Ecclesiasticus 18:13 — *he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.* The bringing again is the lost sheep carried home on the shepherd's shoulders (Luke 15:5).
2 Esdras 13:40 — *carried away prisoners out of their own land.* The lost sheep whose finding the shepherd rejoices over at Luke 15:6.
2 Esdras 2:31 — *Remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth.* The son who was dead and is alive again (Luke 15:24) is that mercy in a parable.

Ecclesiasticus 31:5 — *he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof.* Gold-love disqualifies; at Luke 16:13 the King closes the steward parable with *ye cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon*.
Ecclesiasticus 31:6 — *Gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present..* The servant of mammon in Luke 16:13 walks into the ruin Sirach names.
Ecclesiasticus 31:7 — *them that sacrifice to it, and every fool shall be taken with it.* To serve mammon (Luke 16:13) is to sacrifice to the stumblingblock.
2 Esdras 7:32 — *the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.* The one who might rise from the dead at Luke 16:31 would come from that same holding place.
Ecclesiasticus 36:11 — *inherit you them, as from the beginning.* To seek and save the lost (Luke 19:10) is to gather the tribes Sirach prayed for.
Ecclesiasticus 36:12 — *whom you have named your firstborn.* The lost whom the Son of Adam seeks (Luke 19:10) is the firstborn scattered.

2 Esdras 5:23 — *O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine.* The Hebrew library names the vineyard as the one-only-vine; Luke 20:9's vineyard let out to husbandmen is this chosen vine of Yashar'el (Israel).
2 Esdras 5:27 — *to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.* The vineyard let out at Luke 20:9 is this people, and the fruit sought is the law kept.
2 Esdras 5:24 — *of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit.* At Luke 20:16 the keeping passes to others; the chosen vine stays the Most High's own.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:20 — *Let us condemn him with a shameful death.* The suffering half the Emmaus disciples could not read — *Ought not Messiah (Christ) to have suffered these things* (Luke 24:26).

Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 — *Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.* The glory the Messiah (Christ) enters after suffering (Luke 24:26) is this standing in boldness before those who afflicted him.
Wisdom of Solomon 9:1 — *who have made all things with your word.* The Most High's creating-Word; John 1:1-3's *all things were made by him* walks the same naming.

Wisdom of Solomon 9:9 — *and wisdom was with you ... and was present when you madest the world.* Wisdom present with the Most High at creation; John 1:1-3's *the same was in the beginning with Elohim (God) ... all things were made by him.*

Wisdom of Solomon 7:26 — *the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.* The Formed drawn from the Formless; John 1:4's *the life was the light of men.*

Wisdom of Solomon 7:25 — *the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty.* The Formed flowing from the Formless glory; John 1:14's *we beheld his glory ... of the only begotten of the Father.*
Wisdom of Solomon 7:22 — *wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me.* Wisdom the worker of all things; John 1:3's *all things were made by him* and John 1:14's *full of grace and truth.*

Ecclesiasticus 24:3 — *I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.* Wisdom proceeding from the Most High; John 1:14's Word who came out of the Formless and *was made flesh.*

Ecclesiasticus 24:8 — *he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* Wisdom's tabernacle set in Yashar'el (Israel); John 1:14's *dwelt* (*eskēnōsen,* tabernacled) *among us.*

Ecclesiasticus 24:9 — *he created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.* Wisdom before the world, sent to the inheritance; John 1:11's *he came unto his own, and his own received him not* — the one before the world came to the people Wisdom was sent to.
Baruch 3:29 — *Who has gone up into heaven, and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds.* The question John 3:13 answers: the Son of Adam came down.
Baruch 3:30 — *Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold.* Wisdom past man's reach; the Son of Adam came down from where she dwells (John 3:13).
Baruch 3:37 — *Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men.* The descent John 3:13 names: the Son of Adam who came down from heaven.

Baruch 4:1 — *This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever.* The wisdom Baruch 3 says no man could ascend to fetch is named plainly as the Torah; John 3:12's rebuke falls on a *master of Yashar'el (Israel)* who held that enduring book yet could not see the heavenly thing it carried.

Ecclesiasticus 24:19 — *Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.* Wisdom's call to come and be filled is the offer at the well, *he would have given thee living water* (John 4:10).

Ecclesiasticus 24:21 — *they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.* The thirst that keeps a man coming back to Wisdom; at John 4:14 that same Wisdom in flesh sets the well inside him, *a well of water springing up into everlasting life*.

Sirach 24:23 — *All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.* Wisdom is the Torah-heritage kept in the covenant line; John 4:22's *salvation is of the Yahudim (Jews)* names the same kept inheritance the living water now flows from to the scattered house.
1 Maccabees 4:36 — *let us go up to cleanse and dedicate the sanctuary.* The King cleansed the same house: make not my Father's house an house of merchandise (John 2:16).

2 Maccabees 10:2 — *the altars which the heathen had built ... they pulled down.* The rededication tears down the defilement; John 2:15's *he drove them all out of the temple* with the scourge of cords walks the same casting-out of what encroached on the house of prayer.
Wisdom of Solomon 16:20 — *you feddest your own people with angels’ food.* The crowd cites the same wilderness bread, *He gave them bread from heaven to eat* (John 6:31).
Wisdom of Solomon 16:26 — *it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.* The word that preserved the wilderness is the true bread the Father now gives (John 6:32).
2 Esdras 1:19 — *so you did eat angels’ bread.* The bread of Elohim (God) that comes down from heaven is the one the manna pointed to (John 6:33).

Ecclesiasticus 24:9 — *He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.* Wisdom's own testimony from before the world, dwelling in Jacob and Yashar'el (Israel); *Before Abraham was, I am* (John 8:58) names the same eternity in the Formed Word who came to tabernacle among his own.
Tobit 11:11 — *he strake of the gall on his fathers’ eyes, saying, Be of good hope, my father.* Sight restored by the means appointed; the man born blind *washed, and came seeing* (John 9:7).

Tobit 11:13 — *the whiteness pilled away from the corners of his eyes.* The whiteness-peeled-away moment of restored sight; John 9:25's *whereas I was blind, now I see* names the same restored sight, defended against the court.

Tobit 11:14 — *Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God), and blessed is your name for ever.* The name blessed the moment sight returns; the man whose eyes were opened said *Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him* (John 9:38).

Tobit 11:15 — *you have scourged, and have taken pity on me ... And his son went in rejoicing.* The scourged-then-pitied arc ending in rejoicing; John 9's man born blind, that the works of Elohim (God) be made manifest, ends in worship.

2 Esdras 13:40 — *those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners ... and he carried them over the waters.* The scattered house named tribe-by-tribe; John 10:16's *other sheep ... not of this fold* are the carried-away ten tribes, not the nations grafted in.

2 Esdras 13:47 — *the Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through.* The road home for the scattered ten tribes; John 10:16's *them also I must bring ... one fold, and one shepherd* names the Shepherd who brings them home.
2 Esdras 13:33 — *when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle.* My sheep hear my voice (John 10:27); the hearing shows who they were.
2 Esdras 7:32 — *the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her.* Martha's resurrection at the last day (John 11:24) is this promise, and Lazarus is its first sign.
Baruch 4:37 — *they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One.* The scattered children of Elohim (God) gathered into one (John 11:52).
Baruch 5:5 — *your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One.* The scattered children gathered into one (John 11:52).
Baruch 5:9 — *with the mercy and righteousness that comes from him.* Yashar'el (Israel) led home with joy is the scattered children gathered into one (John 11:52).
Ecclesiasticus 36:11 — *Gather all the tribes of Jacob together.* The children of Elohim (God) scattered abroad (John 11:52) are the tribes this prayer asks home.

2 Esdras 5:23 — *of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine.* Ezra's prayer names the one chosen vine; John 15:1's *I am the true vine* gathers the Hebrew library's figure of Yashar'el (Israel) as the vine Yahuah (God) chose and tended.
Ecclesiasticus 24:17 — *As the vine brought I forth pleasant savour.* The vine of Wisdom planted in Jacob is the true vine of John 15:1.

Ecclesiasticus 24:23 — *the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded.* Wisdom's vine named as the Torah itself; to abide in the true vine of John 15:5 is to abide in the Word the Father spoke.

2 Esdras 5:27 — *among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.* The chosen vine read as the chosen people given the approved law; John 15:8's *Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit* — the chosen vine bearing the fruit it was chosen to bear, to the glory of the husbandman.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:12 — *Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous.* The band with lanterns and torches at John 18:3 is the lying in wait of the ungodly for the righteous one who reproves them.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:13 — *he calls himself the child of Yahuah (God).* The capital charge of John 19:7, he made himself the Son of Elohim (God), is the complaint Wisdom 2:13 gives the ungodly.

Wisdom of Solomon 2:16 — *he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father.* Pilate found no fault at all (John 18:38); the only charge was the one Wisdom named.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:19 — *that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.* The scourging and the crown of thorns at John 19:1–5 are this test carried out, and *Behold the man* is the answer.
Wisdom of Solomon 2:20 — *Let us condemn him with a shameful death.* The resolve that became *Crucify him, crucify him* at John 19:6.

Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 — *he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.* The deliverance came through *It is finished* (John 19:30) and the third day, not by coming down from the cross.
2 Esdras 5:18 — *forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.* Peter, who forsook three times, is charged three times to feed the flock (John 21:15).

Ecclesiasticus 18:13 — *he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.* The Father's own shepherding, handed to the restored Peter in *Feed my sheep* (John 21:16).
Ecclesiasticus 18:14 — *He has mercy on them that receive discipline.* Peter, grieved at the third asking, receives the discipline and the mercy lands as *Feed my sheep* (John 21:17).
Tobit 14:5 — *again Yahuah (God) will have mercy on them, and bring them again into the land* the exile's own gathering-hope — the kingdom restored.
2 Esdras 13:40 — *Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land* the named tribes kept for the latter time, restored.
Ecclesiasticus 48:10 — *to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob* the forerunner's charge — the tribes restored, the hearts turned.
Ecclesiasticus 48:10 — *to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob* the library reads Malachi's Elijah as the restorer of the twelve tribes.
1 Maccabees 14:41 — *until there should arise a faithful prophet* the library keeps watch for the awaited Prophet Peter announces has come.
Ecclesiasticus 44:21 — *that he would bless the nations in his seed … exalt his seed as the stars* the library's witness to the same oath through Abraham's lineage.
2 Maccabees 7:2 — *we are ready to die, rather than to transgress the laws of our fathers* the library's martyrs who obeyed the Torah above the king.

1 Maccabees 2:52 — *Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?* the library's own deathbed recital of the fathers begins, like Stephen, with Abraham (Acts 7:2).
1 Maccabees 2:53 — *Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment and was made lord of Egypt* the library remembers the rejected deliverer lifted to save (Acts 7:9-10).
Ecclesiasticus 35:12 — *Yahuah (God) is judge, and with him is no respect of persons* the Hebrew library repeats the Torah's witness Peter stands on (Acts 10:34).
Tobit 13:5 — *will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* the captivity's hope: the scattered of the house gathered, begun in the repentance granted (Acts 11:18).
Wisdom of Solomon 13:1 — *neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster* the Lystrans' exact error, naming the stars and lights as gods (Acts 14:15).
Tobit 13:5 — *will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* the door of faith as the gathering of the scattered home (Acts 14:27).
Wisdom of Solomon 13:5 — *by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen* the works pointing past themselves to the unknown God (Acts 17:25).
Wisdom of Solomon 13:6 — *they perhaps err, seeking Yahuah (God), and desirous to find him* the groping after the Maker, the seeking that is his summons (Acts 17:27).
Wisdom of Solomon 13:10 — *in dead things is their hope, who call them gods, which are the works of men's hands, gold and silver* the dead works the living Maker is not to be likened to (Acts 17:29).
Wisdom of Solomon 14:8 — *that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it* the idol and its maker under one verdict — Diana and the silversmith (Acts 19:26).
1 Maccabees 2:27 — *Whoever is zealous of the law, and maintaineth the covenant, let him follow me* the same zeal the believing thousands carry — *they are all zealous of the law* (Acts 21:20).
2 Maccabees 7:9 — *the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life* resurrection hope and faithfulness to the law together, as in Paul (Acts 24:15).

2 Maccabees 7:14 — *to look for hope from Yahuah (God) to be raised up again by him: as for you, you shall have no resurrection to life* the just raised, the unjust not — Paul's two-fold hope (Acts 24:15).
2 Maccabees 7:23 — *the Creator … will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again … for his laws' sake* the resurrection as the Creator's mercy upon the law-faithful (Acts 24:15).
Tobit 5:16 — *the angel of Yahuah (God) keep you company* the messenger sent to guard the journey, as the angel of Elohim (God) keeps Paul on the sea (Acts 27:23).
Tobit 5:21 — *the good angel will keep him company … and he shall return safe* the keeping that brings the appointed one and those given him safe through (Acts 27:24,44).
Wisdom of Solomon 13:1 — *neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster* the same indictment Paul presses: the failure is the refusal to read the witness (Romans 1:19).

Wisdom of Solomon 13:5 — *by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen* the creation points past itself to the Creator, clearly seen by the things made (Romans 1:20).
Wisdom of Solomon 14:11 — *the idols of the Gentiles … an abomination, and stumblingblocks to the souls of men* the images of beast and bird Paul names, the made thing become the snare (Romans 1:23).

Wisdom of Solomon 14:12 — *the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life* the root of the exchange: the lie that serves the creature is the headwaters of the whoredom (Romans 1:25).
Wisdom of Solomon 14:22 — *they erred in the knowledge of Yahuah (God) … those so great plagues called they peace* the reprobate mind is the fruit of the rejected knowledge of Elohim (Romans 1:28).

Wisdom of Solomon 14:25 — *there reigned … blood, manslaughter, theft … corruption, unfaithfulness … perjury* the same catalogue Paul walks; the moral collapse follows the worship of the creature (Romans 1:29).

Wisdom of Solomon 14:27 — *the worshipping of idols … is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil* the whole descent under one verdict; the charge of all flesh that sets up the gathering (Romans 1:32).
Wisdom of Solomon 12:19 — *you give repentance for sins* the forbearance of Elohim (God) is the space for return, his goodness leading to repentance (Romans 2:4).
Ecclesiasticus 5:5-6 — *say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified … for mercy and wrath come from him* the warning against the impenitent heart that treasures up wrath (Romans 2:5).
Ecclesiasticus 16:12 — *he judges a man according to his works* mercy and correction both great in him, the deeds weighed (Romans 2:6).
Ecclesiasticus 35:12 — *Yahuah (God) is judge, and with him is no respect of persons* the impartiality Paul names, unbought by gifts or standing (Romans 2:11).
Sirach 44:20 — *who kept the law of the Most High … when he was proved, he was found faithful* the Hebrew library spells the faith as law-keeping and tested faithfulness (Romans 4:3).
1 Maccabees 2:52 — *Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?* the same imputing Paul presses, named as a faithfulness proved in testing (Romans 4:5).
2 Esdras 7:18 — *the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide* the narrow pressure now is the road to the breadth hoped for (Romans 5:3).
2 Esdras 7:14 — *if then they that live labour not to enter these strait … things, they can never receive those that are laid up* no inheritance without the strait endured (Romans 5:4).
Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 — *through envy of the devil came death into the world* the deeper root behind the one man's fall; death the intruder, not the Maker's design (Romans 5:12).

2 Esdras 3:7 — *immediately you appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.* The reign of death from Adam over all his seed (Romans 5:14).
2 Esdras 3:21 — *the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed … and so be all they that are born of him* the inherited fall, the figure of the one to come (Romans 5:14).
2 Esdras 7:48 — *O you Adam … you are not fallen alone, but we all that come of you* the whole fallen race answered by the righteousness of one (Romans 5:18).
2 Esdras 3:20 — *tookest you not away from them a wicked heart, that your law might bring forth fruit* the law atop the unchanged heart, exposing not fruiting (Romans 5:20).

2 Esdras 3:22 — *the law … in the heart of the people with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still* the offence laid bare until the root is dealt with (Romans 5:20).

2 Esdras 3:21 — *the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed … and so be all they that are born of him* the indwelling sin Paul confesses, the inherited wicked heart, not the law (Romans 7:17).

2 Esdras 3:22 — *the law (also) in the heart … with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still* the will to good present, the flesh's root refusing to perform it (Romans 7:18).
2 Esdras 7:48 — *O you Adam, what have you done? … you are not fallen alone, but we all that come of you* the Adamic flesh carried into all, the body of this death (Romans 7:24).

2 Esdras 8:16 — *for Yashar'el (Israel), for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled* the prophet's grief is Paul's grief; mourning for the covenant people is the proof of love, not rejection (Romans 9:2).
Wisdom of Solomon 12:16 — *because you are Yahuah (God) of all, it makes you to be gracious to all* sovereign mercy is the outflow of righteousness, not a cold lottery (Romans 9:15).
Wisdom of Solomon 12:18 — *mastering your power, judgest with equity, and orderest us with great favour* the hand that hardens the oppressor is power mastered and mercy ordered (Romans 9:18).

Wisdom of Solomon 15:7 — *of the same clay he makes both the vessels that serve for clean uses, and likewise also all such as serve to the contrary* the exact figure Paul presses, already worn smooth in the library (Romans 9:21).

2 Esdras 8:2 — *much mould of which earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold comes of* the vessels of mercy afore prepared unto glory are the precious few drawn from the lump (Romans 9:23).
2 Esdras 9:8 — *I have sanctified them for me from the beginning* the saved are set apart before, not chosen after by their response; their salvation reveals what was already true (Romans 9:27).
2 Esdras 9:21 — *have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people* the seed Yahuah left, the grape kept from the cluster, the living root of the gathered people (Romans 9:29).
Baruch 3:29 — *Who has gone up into heaven, and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?* the library reading the same Deuteronomy logic, the heaven-question pressed for wisdom (Romans 10:6).
Baruch 3:30 — *Who has gone over the sea, and found her … ?* the sea-question paired with the heaven-question, exactly as Deuteronomy and Paul pair them (Romans 10:7).

Baruch 3:37 — *afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men* wisdom given to Jacob came down and walked among men — the Formed in flesh, the word brought all the way near (Romans 10:8).

Tobit 13:5 — *will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* the scattering and gathering one motion of one Father; life from the dead made visible (Romans 11:15).
Tobit 13:5 — *he will scourge us … and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations* the concluding under judgment never the last word; mercy the appointed end (Romans 11:30).
Sirach 3:18 — *the greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God)* the sober mind that thinks not too highly is the wisdom-teacher's humility (Romans 12:3).
Sirach 3:18 — *the greater you are, the more humble thyself* to condescend to the low estate is the wisdom-teacher's bending lower (Romans 12:16).
Sirach 7:32 — *stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected* the distributing to the saints is the perfecting of the blessing (Romans 12:13).
Sirach 7:34 — *fail not to be with them that weep, and mourn with them that mourn* the shared sorrow Paul commands, formed long before by the wisdom-teacher (Romans 12:15).
Wisdom of Solomon 6:3 — *power is given you of Yahuah (God) … who shall try your works* the sword is delegated; the ruler answers to the One who armed him (Romans 13:4).
Tobit 1:10 — *all my brothers and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles* the captive's case behind the weak who eateth herbs: the heathen table refused (Romans 14:2).
Tobit 1:11 — *But I kept myself from eating* the same fence the herb-eater keeps in a land of untrusted slaughter, a careful conscience not a loosed commandment (Romans 14:2).
Judith 12:2 — *I will not eat thereof, lest there be an offence* the weak refuses another's table exactly as Judith refused Holofernes' meat (Romans 14:2).

Tobit 13:11 — *many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) … all generations shall praise you with great joy* the nations gathered TO Zion at the restored city, not set up apart from her (Romans 15:9).

Tobit 13:13 — *rejoice and be glad for the children of the just: for they shall be gathered together* the joy of the nations bound to the ingathering of the scattered children; one event (Romans 15:10).

Tobit 14:5 — *bring them again into the land … afterward they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem gloriously* the ingathering Paul offers up: the scattered returning, Jerusalem rebuilt (Romans 15:16).

Tobit 14:6 — *all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols.* The collection for Jerusalem is the turning made tangible, carnal things paid back for spiritual things received (Romans 15:27).

Wisdom of Solomon 7:26 — *the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness* the radiance vocabulary Hebrews fastens to the Son, *the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person* (Hebrews 1:3).
Wisdom of Solomon 7:25 — *a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty.* What flows out from the glory without lessening it is a person in Hebrews 1:3, the brightness of his glory.
Wisdom of Solomon 9:8 — *a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning* the heavenly tabernacle stood first; the earthly is its resemblance (Hebrews 8:5).

Wisdom of Solomon 9:8 — *a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning* — Solomon knew the temple copied the heavenly original behind *the figures of the true* (Hebrews 9:24).
*The King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, to everlasting life* (2 Maccabees 7:9) — the *better resurrection* chosen over deliverance (Hebrews 11:35).
*From him I hope to receive them again* (2 Maccabees 7:11) — the torn body surrendered in the hope of being raised whole (Hebrews 11:35).
*Raised up again by him: as for you, you shall have no resurrection to life* (2 Maccabees 7:14) — the two resurrections named, the *better* one looked for (Hebrews 11:35).
*The Creator of the world... will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again* (2 Maccabees 7:23) — the mother reasons from creation to resurrection (Hebrews 11:35).
*Take your death that I may receive you again in mercy with your brothers* (2 Maccabees 7:29) — the reunion past the grave, *not accepting deliverance* (Hebrews 11:35).
*When he was proved, he was found faithful* (Ecclesiasticus 44:20) — Abraham *when he was tried* (Hebrews 11:17), faith that is faithfulness.
*Exalt his seed as the stars* (Ecclesiasticus 44:21) — the oath behind the seed *so many as the stars of the sky* (Hebrews 11:12).
*Noah was found perfect and righteous... left as a remnant to the earth* (Ecclesiasticus 44:17) — the heir of righteousness preserved through the wrath (Hebrews 11:7).
*Enoch pleased Yahuah (God), and was translated* (Ecclesiasticus 44:16) — the same two words, *pleased* and *translated* (Hebrews 11:5).

1 Maccabees 1:11 — *Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us* the old architecture of the *some that trouble you*: remaking the covenant on the terms of the nations (Galatians 1:7).
1 Maccabees 1:15 — *made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant... joined themselves to the heathen* the flesh-as-doorway politics behind the *other gospel* (Galatians 1:8).

1 Maccabees 2:50 — *be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers* the true covenant zeal set against the counterfeit; the Galatians are removed from him that called, not from the Torah (Galatians 1:6).
1 Maccabees 1:11 — *Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us* the flesh-politics of belonging, the line the agitators stand in (Galatians 2:4).
1 Maccabees 1:15 — *made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant* the mark as a counter in the politics of belonging, undone there, demanded here; both refused (Galatians 2:4).
Ecclesiasticus 44:19 — *Abraham was a great father of many people: in glory was there none like to him* the Second-Temple memory framing the faith that justifies (Galatians 2:16).

Ecclesiasticus 44:20 — *Who kept the law of the Most High... and when he was proved, he was found faithful* faith and faithfulness one cloth; why *justified by the faith of Messiah* is no charter against Torah (Galatians 2:16).

1 Maccabees 2:52 — *Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?* the imputing bound to faithfulness under trial, the reckoning Abraham received (Galatians 2:16).

Sirach 44:20 — *Who kept the law of the Most High... and when he was proved, he was found faithful* the Hebrew library names Abraham's believing as faithfulness, emunah; the children of Abraham trust as he trusted (Galatians 3:7).

1 Maccabees 2:52 — *Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?* the second-temple house read Genesis 15:6 as Paul does; to believe and to be found faithful are one act (Galatians 3:6).

1 Maccabees 2:21 — *Yahuah (God) forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances* the faithful knew the curse answered forsaking the covenant, not keeping it; the agitators' flesh-credential was the forsaking (Galatians 3:10).

1 Maccabees 1:15 — *made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant... and were sold to do mischief* the *yoke of bondage* named: the covenant traded for the favour of the nations, the flesh as credential (Galatians 5:1).

1 Maccabees 1:48 — *leave their children uncircumcised... to the end they might forget the law* circumcision and the whole covenant life were one; the mark as doorway to all the ordinances (Galatians 5:3).

1 Maccabees 2:46 — *what children soever they found... uncircumcised, those they circumcised valiantly* the flesh-mark made a weapon of party-standing — the live politics behind *a debtor to do the whole law* (Galatians 5:3).
1 Maccabees 1:11 — *Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen* the shape of falling from grace: seeking standing by a flesh-arrangement, letting go the grace that kept them (Galatians 5:4).

Tobit 13:16 — *Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone... with pure gold* the restored library's jewelled city for the gathered people, the new Jerusalem named on the overcomer (Revelation 3:12).

2 Esdras 6:38 — *you spakest from the beginning of the creation... Let heaven and earth be made; and your word was a perfect work* the creation by the word, the ground of the elders' worship of the Maker (Revelation 4:11).

2 Esdras 6:20 — *the books shall be opened before the firmament* the heavenly books sealed until the appointed end, the sealed scroll John sees in the right hand of him on the throne (Revelation 5:1).

2 Esdras 14:45 — *that the worthy and unworthy may read it* some books published openly while the hidden ones are sealed and kept back from all but the worthy, the sealed scroll none was found worthy to open (Revelation 5:4).

2 Esdras 2:38 — *behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah (God)* the restored library's sealed and counted company, the sealing and numbering one act of keeping (Revelation 7:3).

2 Esdras 2:38 — *behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah (God)* the restored library's sealed and numbered company, every tribe sealed and reckoned beforehand, kept for the feast (Revelation 7:4).
2 Esdras 2:42 — *I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number* the same uncountable host, gathered and praising Yahuah (God) with songs (Revelation 7:9).

Tobit 13:5 — *he... will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* the multitude of all nations is the scattered seed regathered, mercy after the scourge of exile (Revelation 7:9).

Baruch 5:5 — *behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One* Jerusalem's children returning from the dispersion, the multitude arrived before the throne (Revelation 7:9).
2 Esdras 2:45 — *now are they crowned, and receive palms* the white-robed palm-bearers named: they that confessed the name and came through tribulation (Revelation 7:14).
2 Esdras 2:47 — *It is the Son of Yahuah (God), whom they have confessed in the world* the Lamb is the Son distinguished beside the Father, whom the gathered confessed (Revelation 7:10).

2 Esdras 2:19 — *as many fountains flowing with milk and honey... by which I will fill your children with joy* the restored library's flowing fountains, the living fountains the Lamb leads the gathered to (Revelation 7:17).

2 Esdras 7:30 — *the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments* the restored library's silence at the hinge of judgment, the half-hour hush of the seventh seal (Revelation 8:1).

Tobit 12:15 — *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints* the restored library names the angel's office: the seven holy ones who bear the prayers before the throne (Revelation 8:3).
Tobit 12:12 — *I did bring the remembrance of your prayers before the Holy One* the prayers borne up, not lost in the air; the angel offers them on the golden altar (Revelation 8:3).
Wisdom 14:8 — *that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it* the Hebrew library's verdict on the works-of-hands the unrepentant cling to (Revelation 9:20).

Wisdom 14:27 — *the worshipping of idols... is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil* idolatry as the root that breeds the murders, sorceries, and fornication of verse 21 (Revelation 9:21).

2 Esdras 14:40 — *when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast* Esdras drinks the fiery cup and is filled to speak; the word received equips the prophet from within (Revelation 10:10).

2 Esdras 14:45 — *The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it* the prophet re-sent to publish openly and to seal the rest; the same double charge of sealing and prophesying (Revelation 10:11).
Sirach 48:1 — *Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp* the library remembered Elijah as fire himself; the two candlesticks are these burning lamps (Revelation 11:5).

Sirach 48:9 — *Who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses* the library's memory of Elijah's ascent, the witnesses caught up to heaven in a cloud (Revelation 11:12).

Sirach 48:10 — *ordained for reproofs in their times... and to restore the tribes of Jacob* the office Elijah was ordained to, the pattern of the reproof and regathering the witnesses serve (Revelation 11:11).

2 Esdras 12:32 — *This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them... to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty* the anointed kept in reserve to judge the nations; the wrath come on them that destroy the earth (Revelation 11:18).

2 Maccabees 2:4 — *the prophet... commanded the tabernacle and the ark to go with him, as he went forth into the mountain* Jeremiah hiding the ark in the mountain; the ark now seen openly in the temple of heaven (Revelation 11:19).

2 Maccabees 2:5 — *he found an hollow cave, in which he laid the tabernacle, and the ark, and the altar of incense, and so stopped the door* the ark sealed in the cave against the appointed time, unsealed when the heavenly temple is opened (Revelation 11:19).

2 Maccabees 2:7 — *it shall be unknown until the time that Yahuah (God) gather his people again together, and receive them to mercy* the ark hidden until the gathering; the showing of the ark is the sign the gathering has come (Revelation 11:19).

2 Maccabees 2:8 — *Then shall Yahuah (God) shew them these things, and the glory of Yahuah (God) shall appear, and the cloud also, as it was shewed under Moses* the hidden ark shown and the glory-cloud returned at the gathering, exactly as the heavenly temple is opened (Revelation 11:19).

Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 — *through envy of the devil came death into the world* the Hebrew library knows the dragon as death's author; the one cast down loosed the death the Lamb's blood overturns (Revelation 12:9).
2 Esdras 11:1 — *there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads* the restored library's sea-beast of many heads, reigning over all the earth (Revelation 13:1).

2 Esdras 12:11 — *The eagle... is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of your brother Daniel* the interpreting voice ties Ezra's sea-eagle to Daniel's vision; a witness beside John's beast out of the sea, not its key (Revelation 13:1).

2 Esdras 11:39 — *Art not you it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world* the eagle named the last of Daniel's four beasts; the composite beast is that surviving fourth reign (Revelation 13:1).

2 Esdras 2:42 — *upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah (God) with songs* the restored library's company on Sion, beyond number, singing the song of the redeemed (Revelation 14:1).

2 Esdras 2:45 — *they that... have confessed the name of Yahuah (God): now are they crowned, and receive palms* the crowned palm-bearers who bear the Name; the sealed with the Father's name in their foreheads (Revelation 14:1).

2 Esdras 2:40 — *those of yours that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of Yahuah (God)* the law-keepers of Sion clothed in white; the same sign as they that keep the commandments and the faith of Yahusha (Jesus) (Revelation 14:12).
2 Esdras 4:30 — *the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam... until the time of threshing come* the reaping of the earth is the threshing-time (Revelation 14:16).

2 Esdras 4:32 — *when the ears shall be cut down, which are without number, how great a floor shall they fill?* the earth reaped, the floor filled with the ears of the evil seed, the tares cut down first (Revelation 14:16).

Wisdom of Solomon 10:20 — *the righteous... praised your holy name, O Yahuah (God)... yours hand, that fought for them* the Hebrew library remembers the redeemed praising with one accord after the Red sea, the posture of the victors with the harps (Revelation 15:2).

2 Esdras 2:42 — *upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah (God) with songs* the Hebrew library beholds the numberless company singing on Sion, the exalted young man crowning them, the posture of the victors with the harps (Revelation 15:2).

Wisdom 11:16 — *wherewithal a man sinneth, by the same also shall he be punished* the law of the bowls named in the Hebrew library; the blood-shedders judged by blood, the recompence fitting and so righteous (Revelation 16:5).

2 Esdras 13:34 — *an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together... to overcome him by fighting* the Hebrew library beheld the nations massed against the Man on mount Sion; the kings gathered to the battle of that great day (Revelation 16:14).

Wisdom 16:16 — *the ungodly, that denied to know you... with strange rains, hails, and showers, were they persecuted... and through fire were they consumed* the Hebrew library's memory of the Egypt hail on the deniers; the same hail on the men who blaspheme and repent not (Revelation 16:21).

2 Esdras 11:1 — *there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads* the multi-headed, many-winged ruler from the sea, its heads and wings the kings; the scarlet beast with seven heads and ten horns (Revelation 17:3).

2 Esdras 12:11 — *The eagle, whom you sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of your brother Daniel* the Hebrew library names the eagle as Daniel's fourth kingdom; the same kingdom is the harlot's mount (Revelation 17:3).

2 Esdras 15:47 — *made thyself like to her; and have decked your daughters in whoredom... your lovers* the harlot-city idiom in the restored library; the *MOTHER OF HARLOTS* who draws the nations into fornication (Revelation 17:5).

2 Esdras 15:53 — *you had... always slain my chosen... saying over their dead, when you were drunken* the slaying of the chosen and drunken triumph over their dead; the woman drunk with the blood of the martyrs (Revelation 17:6).

2 Esdras 15:55 — *The reward of your whoredom shall be in your bosom, therefore shall you receive recompence* the law of the harlot's end; her wages paid back as the horns make her desolate (Revelation 17:16).
2 Esdras 15:61 — *you shall be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be to you as fire* the powers become fire to the harlot-city; the horns *shall... burn her with fire* (Revelation 17:16).

2 Esdras 16:41 — *He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose* the Hebrew library's overturning of all commerce behind *no man buyeth their merchandise any more* (Revelation 18:11).

2 Esdras 16:42 — *He that occupieth merchandise, as he that has no profit by it: and he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell in it* the merchant's trade made nothing in the day of trouble (Revelation 18:11).

Baruch 4:35 — *For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting... and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time* the Hebrew library's doom of the city behind *the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee* (Revelation 18:23).

2 Esdras 2:40 — *shut up those of yours that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of Yahuah (God)* the restored library's white-clad law-keepers, the fine linen that is the righteousness of saints (Revelation 19:8).

Tobit 12:18 — *not of any favour of mine, but by the will of our Elohim (God) I came; wherefore praise him for ever* Raphael deflecting all honour to the One, as the angel refuses John's worship — *worship Elohim (God)* (Revelation 19:10).

Wisdom of Solomon 18:15-16 — *your Almighty word leaped down from heaven... as a sharp sword* the Word as a warrior, the Formed leaping from the throne, named The Word of Elohim (God) (Revelation 19:13,15).

2 Esdras 13:10 — *out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire... a flaming breath* the Man from the sea destroying the nations with the breath of his mouth, the sword from the rider's mouth (Revelation 19:15,21).
2 Esdras 13:37-38 — *this my Son shall rebuke... destroy them... by the law which is like to fire* the Son on Sion destroying the nations by the word, not by armies (Revelation 19:15).

2 Esdras 7:32 — *the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her... the secret places shall deliver those souls* the great restoring of all the sleepers for judgment after the thousand years; the first resurrection is the early exception before it (Revelation 20:5).

2 Esdras 7:33 — *the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end* the one great assize of the souls of the dead, the white throne whence earth and heaven flee (Revelation 20:11).
Tobit 13:10 — *his tabernacle may be builded in you again with joy... those that are captives* the captives' prayer from exile answered in the city descending from Elohim (God) (Revelation 21:10).
2 Esdras 10:27 — *the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city builded* the mourning woman who is Sion transformed into a city, the bride who is the New Jerusalem (Revelation 21:2).
2 Esdras 13:36 — *Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded* the prepared Sion not made with hands, the holy Jerusalem descending out of heaven (Revelation 21:10).

Tobit 13:16 — *Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone: your walls... with pure gold* the Hebrew library's gold-and-gemstone Jerusalem, raised in the city pure gold (Revelation 21:18).
Tobit 13:17 — *the streets of Jerusalem shall be paved with beryl and carbuncle and stones of Ophir* the streets foreseen in captivity, seen as the street of pure gold (Revelation 21:21).
2 Esdras 7:26 — *the bride shall appear... that now is withdrawn from the earth* the Hebrew library's hidden city shown at last, open only to those in the Lamb's book of life (Revelation 21:27).
2 Esdras 8:52 — *paradise opened, the tree of life is planted... a city is builded* the whole vision named in one breath; Eden become the new Jerusalem (Revelation 22:2).
2 Esdras 8:53 — *the root of evil is sealed up from you... and corruption is fled* the root of the curse sealed away; what remains is the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb (Revelation 22:3).
2 Esdras 8:54 — *Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality* the sorrow of the curse passed, the immortality of the unending reign shown (Revelation 22:3,5).
2 Esdras 8:52 — *paradise opened, the tree of life is planted... a city is builded* the threefold gift of the righteous, named in one line as the beatitude names it (Revelation 22:14).

Sirach 1:1 — *All wisdom comes from Yahuah (God), and is with him for ever* the wisdom no disputer can win, found in *Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God)* (1 Corinthians 1:24).
Sirach 1:14 — *To fear Yahuah (God) is the beginning of wisdom* the true wisdom the world counts foolish; *the foolishness of Elohim (God) is wiser than men* (1 Corinthians 1:25).

Sirach 1:26 — *If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and Yahuah (God) shall give her to you* wisdom the gift, not the flesh-credential; made ours in the Messiah *who of Elohim (God) is made unto us wisdom* (1 Corinthians 1:30).

Wisdom of Solomon 2:1 — *the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright... neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave* the world's wisdom that counts death final, to which *the preaching of the cross... is foolishness* (1 Corinthians 1:18).
Wisdom of Solomon 2:21 — *and were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them.* The root of the false wisdom Elohim (God) *made foolish* (1 Corinthians 1:20).
Wisdom of Solomon 2:22 — *the mysteries of Yahuah (God), they knew them not* the library's diagnosis Paul re-speaks: *the world by wisdom knew not Elohim (God)* (1 Corinthians 1:21).

Wisdom of Solomon 9:13 — *For what man is he that can know the counsel of Yahuah (God)?* the library's question that the hidden wisdom *which Elohim (God) ordained before the world* (1 Corinthians 2:7) answers.

Wisdom of Solomon 9:17 — *except you give wisdom, and send your Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) from above* the counsel known only by the Spirit sent from above; *the Spirit searcheth... the deep things of Elohim (God)* (1 Corinthians 2:10).
Sirach 1:10 — wisdom *given to them that love him,* and *created before all things* (Sirach 1:4); the wisdom *ordained before the world,* prepared *for them that love him* (1 Corinthians 2:7,9).

Wisdom of Solomon 2:22 — *the mysteries of Yahuah (God), they knew them not,* the ungodly whom *wickedness has blinded* (Wisdom 2:21); the princes who *would not have crucified Yahuah (Lord) of glory* had they known (1 Corinthians 2:8).

Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *yet is their hope full of immortality.* The reward of the righteous the ungodly neither hoped for nor discerned (Wisdom of Solomon 2:22); the unseen *things which Elohim (God) hath prepared for them that love him* (1 Corinthians 2:9).

Wisdom of Solomon 2:19 — *Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture... that we may know his meekness* the Hebrew library's righteous-one set up for derision; the apostles *appointed to death... a spectacle unto the world* (1 Corinthians 4:9).

Ecclesiasticus 15:15 — *If you will, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness* the wisdom-library's same measure; the kept commandment and faithfulness performed, not the flesh-credential (1 Corinthians 7:19).

Wisdom of Solomon 13:10 — *in dead things is their hope, who call them gods, which are the works of men's hands... a stone good for nothing* the library's witness that *an idol is nothing in the world* (1 Corinthians 8:4).
